title: Executive Operations & Client Success Concierge
description:
Job Description: Executive Operations & Client Success Concierge



About the role: An established personal-development and coaching business (content-driven online education grounded in neuroscience and resilience) is hiring a warm, proactive right hand. The founder is a sought-after coach, speaker, and content creator who is systematizing the business so it runs smoothly and is preparing to launch a second brand. This person becomes the welcoming face of the client experience and the founder's operational right hand, and grows with the company across both brands.



Role overview: You are the person clients meet first and the founder leans on daily. You guide new clients through a warm, well-run onboarding, support them through their journey, and quietly keep the operation moving behind the scenes: client systems, travel, inbox, and AI-assisted workflows. You wake up asking what needs to happen today so the founder can coach, speak, create, and sell. This is a proactive ownership role with real client contact, not a back-office task seat.



Primary Responsibilities (Client Success & Concierge)

Be the friendly face of the brand: run client onboarding calls (about 45 minutes each), welcome new clients, and make them feel cared for from day one.

Monitor and support the community message thread, answer common questions, and surface anything that needs the founder.

Track client milestones and graduations, and keep each client moving through the program.

Act as a gentle gatekeeper, protecting the founder's time while keeping clients feeling close.



Onboarding & Operations (GoHighLevel)

Run the GoHighLevel onboarding workflow end to end: confirm the client is in the CRM, apply the correct onboarding tag so the automations fire, and set up each client's folder cleanly.

Use the sales-call transcript and an AI project to assemble each client's goals and roadmap accurately.

Keep backend systems organized and document SOPs so the business runs without constant founder input.



Executive Support

Own personal and executive travel end to end: flights, hotels, ground transport, itineraries, anticipating needs, handling changes, and managing related spend responsibly.

Triage the founder's inbox, surface what needs attention, and draft responses where appropriate.



LinkedIn & Outreach Support

Manage the LinkedIn inbox and monitor automated outreach in HeyReach, sending approved, templated replies and timely follow-ups (content posting is handled separately).

Flag inbound opportunities (podcasts, speaking, partnerships) and prepare them for founder review in short, focused co-working sessions where the founder makes the final call.



AI & Systems

Use AI tools, especially Claude, to speed up onboarding, content assembly, and admin, and help build and maintain simple AI projects against the business's knowledge base.



Required skills (must-have, screened directly)

Genuine client-facing warmth and presence, with strong judgment about people and situations. This is the heart of the role.

Proven experience supporting a coach, creator, or solo founder as an EA or client success lead.

Demonstrated hands-on travel management for a principal, including anticipating needs, handling changes, and managing spend and reconciliation.

Comfortable and credible working within a Christian and scripture-based context, to support the founder's second brand.

Excellent spoken and written English with a neutral, easy-to-understand accent for client calls.

Highly organized, reliable, and proactive: anticipates needs and takes direction once, then runs with it.



Important and strongly preferred (trainable)

GoHighLevel experience. It is the primary onboarding and client-management system and matters, but it is teachable, so strong candidates without it are still worth considering.

Working knowledge of AI tools and prompting (training provided).

HeyReach or similar LinkedIn outreach tools.

Light content production or coordination.

title: Creative Strategist & Ad Designer – Health/Beauty DTC (Meta Ads + Funnels)
description:
CREATIVE STRATEGIST & AD DESIGNER — HEALTH & BEAUTY DTC (META ADS + FUNNELS)



WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS

We're a fast-growing health & beauty DTC brand — supplements and wellness products — scaling across multiple international markets on Meta paid ads driving to Funnelish funnels.



Our growth lives and dies on creative. This is a rare two-in-one seat: you'll find the winning angle AND build the creative yourself. You research what's working, read the performance data, work out WHY it wins at each stage of the funnel — then design the static that goes live. No long handoffs, nothing lost in translation. If you're an ambitious creative who can both think strategically and design clean, scroll-stopping ads, this is built for you.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Design the creative — produce finished, ready-to-run static ads, thumbnails, and AI statics in our brand style, from concept to launch-ready file

- Analyse funnels end to end — match creative and messaging to the right funnel stage (awareness, consideration, decision) and flag where creative and offer are out of sync

- Swipe winners daily — research high-performing ads from competitors and reference brands (Meta Ad Library, TikTok, etc.), then adapt the angle into something fresh.

- Read the analytics — use spend, ROAS, CTR, CPM and VSL performance to d
 what to scale, kill, and design next

- Develop VSL & video angles — write the hook, lead, and script our video editor turns into VSLs (you brief video, you design statics)



WHO YOU ARE (MUST-HAVES)

- Design skills are essential — you can produce scroll-stopping statics fast (Photoshop / Figma / Canva or similar), with a strong eye for hierarchy, hooks, and what stops the scroll on Meta

- Health/beauty background is essential — proven experience with supplements, wellness, beauty or similar, with a portfolio to show it

- Funnel analysis is critical — you genuinely understand funnel stages and customer awareness, and design to match each

- You've swiped, briefed and built Meta ad creative before — static, plus VSL/video at the angle level

- Comfortable turning performance metrics into creative decisions

- Familiar with Funnelish or similar funnel builders (ClickFunnels, etc.)

- Strong written English, organised, fast, and able to self-manage a daily output target



NICE TO HAVE

AI creative tools (AI statics / AI UGC), light motion or video, multi-market experience, Klaviyo, ClickUp, HiggsField, Veo3.



WHAT YOU'LL DELIVER

- Weekly creative batches — finished, launch-ready statics every week, plus angles/scripts for video

- Swipe + analysis notes — what's winning, why, and the funnel stage it targets

- Performance-driven recommendations — what to scale, kill, and design next, backed by the numbers



COMPENSATION — BUILT TO REWARD OUTPUT AND WINS

We don't pay for hours — we pay for production and performance:

- a monthly base for your core engine (daily swiping, swipe breakdowns, weekly analysis)

- output pay on every creative you produce and we approve — the more strong, launch-ready ads you ship, the more you earn

- an uncapped performance bonus every time a creative you made becomes a winner we scale

On-target earnings land around $1,000–1,500/month, with genuine upside for top performers and a clear path into a senior strategist role. We start every hire with a short paid trial task, and walk you through exact rates then.



HOW TO APPLY (read carefully — this is how we filter)

Applications that skip these steps go straight to trash:

1. Start your message with the word "SWIPE" so we know you read the whole post.

2. Answer this: We're launching a brand-new supplement in a category where the customer doesn't yet know this type of product exists. Which awareness stage are these buyers in, and what kind of ad would you lead with to warm them up? (2-3 sentences.)

3. Share a portfolio or 3-4 examples of static ads you've designed — ideally health/beauty — with one line each on the angle and why it worked.

4. Tell us which design and AI tools you use to produce statics.



Nail this and you'll hear from us fast.

title: Pinterest Content & Listing Specialist — You Get the Product. You Build Everything.
description:
This role is not for everyone. Read carefully before applying.



We run fast-growing Pinterest dropshipping stores across multiple niches. We're looking for ONE person who can take a product and turn it into a complete, conversion-ready Pinterest presence — listing, copy, creatives, and pins — without constant supervision.



You won't be responsible for finding products.



We'll provide the product.



Your job is to turn it into something people actually want to click on.



How We Work



You receive a product.



You deliver everything.



• Shopify product listing (clean, consistent, conversion-focused)



• Pinterest-optimized title and description using real keyword research



• 5–6 creatives found/designed to stop the scroll



• Pins uploaded and organized with proper Pinterest SEO



That's one task. Not four.



What You'll Be Doing



• Creating high-quality Shopify product listings



• Writing Pinterest-optimized titles and descriptions



• Finding/Creating multiple Pinterest creatives and testing different angles



• Maintaining clean, consistent, conversion-focused product pages



• Uploading and organizing Pinterest content



• Spotting mistakes, inconsistencies, and opportunities for improvement without being asked



• Continuously looking for ways to improve the quality and performance of your work



What We Need From You



• Proven Shopify listing experience



• Strong Canva skills



• Solid written English



• Strong attention to detail



• Ability to work independently



• Good judgment when presenting products visually



• The ability to understand what makes a product appealing and communicate that through content and creatives



What Separates Great Applicants From Average Ones



Average applicants complete the checklist.



Great applicants look at a product and immediately understand:



Who wants this?



Why do they want it?



What would make them click?



They notice the USP hidden in the reviews.



They write titles that match what people actually search for.



They create Pinterest content that feels native to the platform rather than looking like an advertisement.



That's who we're looking for.



This Is NOT The Right Role If



• You need constant direction



• You rush through tasks



• "Good enough" is acceptable to you



• You rarely double-check your work



• You view listings and creatives as separate tasks instead of one complete process



This IS The Right Role If



• You think of a product as a story to tell, not a form to fill



• You genuinely enjoy creating high-quality content



• You take pride in every listing you publish



• You enjoy improving processes



• You want to grow with a business long-term



• You notice things nobody asked you to notice — and you mention them



To Apply



1. Tell us about your experience with Shopify product listing.



2. Tell us about your experience with Pinterest (SEO, boards, scheduling, content creation, etc.).



3. Show us a real example of a listing, pin, or creative you've made. Screenshots are required.



4. What is one mistake most Pinterest listers make?



5. What is one thing you would improve about a Pinterest store you've worked on in the past?



6. What are your working hours and timezone?



7. Attach a screenshot of your internet speed test.



Important



Start your application with the word:



DIAMOND



Applications that do not follow these instructions exactly will not be considered. This is intentional.



Final-stage applicants may be asked to complete a small paid test project.

title: Software Developer
description:
***PLEASE READ ON HOW TO APPLY***



Job Title: Software Developer

Location: Remote | Philippines based ONLY

Salary Range: Php 180,000 per month

A MUST: Minimum of 5 years of solid experience



We’re looking for talented Software Developers to join our remote-first team. In this role, you’ll be responsible for

building and maintaining responsive, high-performing full- stack web applications using Next.js, Tailwind CSS, and

Supabase.



Our ideal candidate writes clean, maintainable code, takes ownership of their work, and thrives in a fast-paced

startup environment where autonomy, communication, and craftsmanship are valued.



Key Responsibilities

- Design, develop, and maintain web applications using TypeScript, React, and Next.js.

- Work with Supabase (PostgreSQL) to design, query, and optimise relational database schemas.

- Integrate third-party APIs, including reading, understanding, and applying API documentation.

- Implement responsive, accessible, and performant user interfaces with Tailwind CSS.

- Utilise AI-powered tools (e.g. Cursor, Claude, and similar) to accelerate development while

maintaining high code quality and exercising sound engineering judgment over AI-generated output.

- Collaborate with other developers and/or stakeholders to refine requirements, propose technical solutions, and deliver features on agreed timelines.

- Work with background jobs and scheduled tasks using Inngest (or similar services) for cron-like and event-driven workflows.

- Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve issues across the stack, including in production environments.

- Produce clear technical documentation for features, architectural decisions, and processes.

- Communicate proactively and clearly within a remote team, including written updates and participation in online meetings across UK-Philippines time zones.



Must-Have Skills:

- Strong proficiency in TypeScript, React, and Next.js

- Experience with Supabase or relational databases (PostgreSQL)

- Ability to read and integrate third-party API documentation

- Strong understanding of Tailwind CSS and responsive design principles

- Familiarity with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and modern development workflows

- Ability to work independently and manage time effectively in a remote environment

- Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail

- Comfortable using AI-assisted development tools while maintaining engineering judgment and security best practices



Nice-to-Have Skills

- Experience with React Native and mobile development tools (Expo, Xcode, Android Studio)

- Experience with Inngest or similar background job / cron orchestration tools

- Familiarity with Vercel serverless and edge functions



Tech Stack



Primary:

- TypeScript

- React

- Next.js

- Tailwind CSS

- Supabase (PostgreSQL)



Secondary / Bonus:

- React Native

- Expo

- Python



Tools & Platforms:

- Git / GitHub

- Vercel

- Supabase

- Inngest

- Standard remote collaboration tools (Slack/Teams, Jira/Linear or equivalent)



***PLEASE READ ON HOW TO APPLY***



How to Apply:

To apply for this role, please submit a link to your resume and a brief Loom video (max 2 minutes) introducing yourself and highlighting your skills relevant to the role. In your video, please address the following:

- A short introduction of yourself and why you're interested in this role.

- Your previous experience as a Software Developer and specific experience with Next JS/Supabase

- Key skills or qualifications that make you a strong fit for this position.



Please note: Applications without a video will not be reviewed. We look forward to welcoming a passionate developer who prioritizes clean code, performance optimization, and delivering exceptional user experiences.

title: Senior GL Accountant (US Focus)
description:

This role is ideal for accounting professionals who are confident working independently, partnering cross-functionally, and operating within process-driven finance environments that value accuracy, accountability, and continuous improvement.



Who This Role Is For



We are looking for professionals who thrive in:

• US accounting environments

• Multi-entity operations

• Cross-functional finance teams

• High-volume and fast-paced close cycles

• Process-driven accounting environments

• Roles requiring strong ownership and accountability



Role Overview



The Senior GL Accountant will take ownership of key accounting functions including:

• General ledger management

• Month-end and year-end close

• Financial reporting support

• Balance sheet reconciliations

• Audit preparation and compliance

• Process improvement initiatives



Depending on business needs, the role may also support multi-entity reporting structures and cross-functional finance operations.



Key Responsibilities

General Ledger & Close

• Own and manage assigned general ledger accounts

• Prepare and review journal entries including:

Accruals

Deferrals

Depreciation

Amortization

Reclassifications

Revenue and expense adjustments



• Lead monthly, quarterly, and annual close activities

• Perform and review balance sheet reconciliations and bank reconciliations

• Investigate and resolve reconciling items promptly

• Maintain accurate supporting schedules and audit-ready workpapers

• Ensure completeness and accuracy of financial records



Financial Reporting & Analysis

• Support preparation of monthly financial reports and supporting schedules

• Perform variance and flux analysis with clear explanations

• Assist with management reporting and ad hoc financial analysis

title: Digital Marketing Manager
description:
## Job Title: Digital Marketing Manager (Philippines-Based)



### About Us



[Unicorn Buyers Agents (UBA)](
) is Sydney’s premier boutique buyers agency for owner-occupiers and investors. Led by our Director, Dan Sofo, we help families, first-time buyers, and expats navigate one of the toughest, most competitive property markets in the world.



We don't just find houses; we secure dreams. To date, we have bought over 200+ properties worth more than $460M+, with 72% of our deals secured completely off-market or pre-auction. Based in beautiful Paddington, Sydney, we hold a flawless reputation backed by 99+ five-star Google reviews. We are elite at what we do—now, we want our digital footprint to match.



### The Vision: Own Our Marketing, Shape Our Future



We are not looking for a Virtual Assistant to check off a daily to-do list. We are looking for an independent, strategic partner who will become an integral part of our core team.



Right now, Dan is driving the ideas. **The goal of this role is to change that.** We want a high performer who will take the raw clay of our brand, our data, and Dan's insights, and use them to shape the future of how UBA performs online. You will start by executing our current framework, but your ultimate mandate is to outgrow it—introducing new channels (like Substack), mastering emerging tech (like AEO), and independently driving our entire marketing roadmap without needing to be told what to do.



If you want a job where you are a valued builder, not just a cog in a machine, this is your canvas.



---



### Position Details & Career Progression Roadmap



We want to invest heavily in the right person. This position is structured to scale alongside your performance and commitment to the brand.



* **Year 1 Commitment (Part-Time):** * **Hours:** 30 hours per week (6 hours/day), Monday to Friday

* **Shift:** 8:00 AM – 2:00 PM Philippine Time (PHST) — aligning perfectly with high-stakes Sydney business hours.

* **Remuneration:** $1,000 AUD per month





* **Year 2 & Beyond (Guaranteed Career Progression):**

* **Guaranteed Pay Increase:** Upon reaching your 1-year tenure milestone, you will receive a **guaranteed 10% pay increase**.

* **Full-Time Upgrade:** At the 1-year mark, this role will **upgrade to a full-time, 40-hour-per-week position**, allowing you to fully step into your role as our dedicated Marketing Driver.





* **Location:** Remote (Philippines)



---



### Key Responsibilities & Future Growth Levers



**1. Content Production & Social Media (Western Channels)**



* Take Dan’s raw video footage from property inspections, market updates, and media appearances, and edit it into sharp, premium content.

* Produce **3–4 long-form videos (1–3 minutes)** per week for YouTube and LinkedIn, and strategically repurpose them into highly engaging **short-form clips (30–60 seconds)**.

* Manage, post, and optimize content across **Meta 
/Instagram), TikTok, LinkedIn, and YouTube**.



**2. Copywriting &
 Marketing (Moving to Substack)**



* Take our deep property insights and update the UBA website with regular, SEO-friendly blog posts.

* Repurpose those insights into high-signal, engaging articles on **LinkedIn** to capture corporate professionals.

* Manage and deploy our client and investor newsletters using **MailerLite**—with the immediate strategic goal of helping us launch, build, and monetize a premium presence on **Substack**.



**3. Chinese Social Media Management (WeChat & Redbook)**



* A massive growth lever for UBA is the Chinese-Australian and expat buyer market. You will take the lead on launching, managing, and growing our brand accounts on **WeChat Business** and **Xiaohongshu (Red/Redbook)** from scratch.



**4. Performance Marketing & Future-Proofing (Google & AEO)**



* Create, split-test, and optimize **Google Paid Ads** to continuously funnel high-quality discovery calls to Dan’s calendar.

* **Drive our AEO (Answer Engine Optimization) efforts:** The future of search is changing. You will optimize our written and video content so that UBA is the definitive answer served by AI tools like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google Gemini when affluent buyers search for Sydney property advice.



---



### Why a High Performer Should Join Us (What's In It For You)



* **A Transparent Future:** We map out your growth from day one. Prove your value in year one, and unlock guaranteed higher pay and full-time security in year two.

* **True Autonomy:** We don’t track every click; we track results, creativity, and initiative. You will have the freedom to test new ideas, fail fast, and build something you are proud of.

* **Work Directly with a Thought Leader:** You will report directly to Dan Sofo. Dan is a hands-on, highly energetic Director who understands the value of elite marketing and will give you the resources and trust you need to succeed.

* **An Unlimited Creative Sandbox:** Real estate is inherently visual and emotional. You'll be working with high-end Sydney property data, luxury property walkthroughs, and incredible client success stories. The "raw material" you get to work with is elite.



---



### Requirements & Qualifications



* **Extreme Initiative:** If you are the type of person who waits for instructions, please do not apply. We want a self-starter who looks at our current marketing, identifies the gaps, and says, *"Hey Dan, I noticed we aren't optimizing for X, so I created a draft strategy for it."*

* **Exceptional English & Aussie Nuance:** Our clients are buying multimillion-dollar properties. You must have flawless written and spoken English, and crucially, understand Australian cultural nuances, real estate terminology (auctions, off-market, passing-in), and tone.

* **Elite Creativity:** You know how to edit videos so people actually watch past the first 3 seconds. You have an eye for sleek typography, clean transitions, and pacing.

* **Technical & Forward-Thinking Stack:** Experienced in premium video editing tools, MailerLite (and ideally Substack), Google Ads Manager, Western/Chinese social media dashboards, and an understanding of modern AI search behavior (AEO/SEO).

* **Reliability:** Strict availability Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM – 2:00 PM PHST. Must have a rock-solid internet connection and a reliable backup power solution.



---



### How to Apply



We move fast. If you have the drive to turn Unicorn Buyers Agents into a digital content powerhouse and shape the future of our brand, please submit:



1. **Your updated resume.**

2. **A video introduction (1–2 minutes):** Tell Dan who you are and why you are the independent, strategic marketer he is looking for.

3. **Examples of your long-form writing work:** Since you will be taking over our website blogs, LinkedIn articles, and launching our Substack, please provide examples of long-form written content (e.g., articles, newsletters, or comprehensive blog posts) that demonstrate your ability to articulate complex ideas with a sharp, professional, and engaging tone.

4. **A link to your video editing portfolio/previous social media work.**

description:
1. Overview & Company Philosophy

We are seeking an exceptionally organized, systematic, and detail-oriented Executive Virtual Assistant to act as a direct personal anchor and operational filter for a multi-venture business owner. 



Please note: You will assist the owner personally in managing their executive responsibilities across two separate companies. You will work directly for the owner, rather than working for or being embedded within either of the corporate entities themselves.



This role is designed to act as a defensive shield between the owner and daily operational chaos, allowing them to shift from a reactive mindset into high-level business execution. If you take extreme pride in system order and structural consistency, we want you to be our partner in building that order. 



2. Core Responsibilities

You will manage three tightly systemized personal workflows for the owner on a daily basis:

a. Weekly Preparation & Cross-Inbox Management: Act as the primary gatekeeper and filter for the owner’s separate corporate mailboxes. Clear out operational noise, flag messages requiring immediate attention, and archive/log administrative items. Curate and prepare the owner's personal master schedule every Friday afternoon, creating a blueprint block map for the upcoming week.

b. Personal Briefing & Meeting Coordination: Coordinate recurring meetings and streamline multi-calendar scheduling native to Outlook. title: Backend & Automation Developer (Part-Time: 5–10 Hours/Week) — T-SQL, Python, & N8N
description:
ABOUT US



We are a growing business ecosystem guided by classical operational principles of stewardship, order, and progress. We pride ourselves on hands-on prototyping. We quickly build functional, "vibe-coded" mockups and workflows that prove a business concept works.



Now, we are looking for a sharp, detail-oriented Online Filipino Specialist (OFS) to serve as our Backend & Automation Developer. Your primary mission will be to step in behind our prototype logic, refactor it, clean it up, and make it bulletproof, performant, and production-ready.



ROLE OVERVIEW & RESPONSIBILITIES



This is a flexible, highly focused part-time position requiring 5 to 10 hours per week. You will be working directly with the business owner asynchronously.



Your day-to-day responsibilities will include:



T-SQL Refactoring & Optimization: Reviewing draft SQL queries built for dashboards, rewriting inefficient joins, implementing proper indexing, and formatting code to ensure peak database performance.



Python Script Optimization: Reviewing, modularizing, and optimizing existing Python scripts. This includes adding structured logging, implementing clean error-handling blocks, and managing API payloads.



N8N Workflow Orchestration: Building and organizing workflows within N8N to automate backend tasks. You will manage and refactor API calls, handle webhooks, and map data across platforms.



Asynchronous Collaboration: Reviewing video walkthroughs (such as Loom screen recordings) detailing project specifications, asking clarifying questions, and independently delivering optimized code.



REQUIRED SKILLS & TECHNICAL STACK



Database Management: Strong proficiency in T-SQL / MS SQL Server. You must understand query optimization, indexing, explicit joins, and database security best practices.



Programming Languages: Proficiency in Python for backend scripting, data manipulation, and working with REST APIs (using libraries such as requests, json, pandas, etc.).



Automation Workflow Tools: Direct, practical experience utilizing N8N (or closely related node-based automation platforms like Make or Zapier) to build and troubleshoot API integrations.



Quality Assurance Mindset: Strong code optimization skills. You should naturally write self-documenting code with clear variable naming, modular structures, and comprehensive error handling.



Communication: Exceptional written English. Because this role is asynchronous, you must be comfortable tracking down task details independently and articulating technical concepts clearly via text or video.



WORK SCHEDULE, EXPECTATIONS, & CULTURE



Weekly Hours: 5 to 10 hours per week.



Flexible Schedule: You can work your own hours during the day or night. We value output and code quality over the exact time on the clock.



No Micromanagement: We do not use invasive, screenshot-taking time-trackers. Instead, we gauge your value based on the elegance, readability, and reliability of your code.



Daily Reports: To keep tasks moving smoothly, we require a quick, simple end-of-day
 report answering three questions (even if you worked 0 hours that day):

What did you work on/complete today?

What roadblocks or issues did you encounter?

What are your next steps?



Culture of Ownership: We encourage an environment of high accountability and low fear. We expect you to speak up if our prototype logic is flawed. Your job is to point out mistakes, suggest better architectural patterns, and systematically take ownership of the code quality.



COMPENSATION & TRUST-BUILDING TERMS



Hourly Rate: Competitive hourly rate based on technical experience and depth of skills. Let us know your expected hourly rate in your application.



Weekly Payments: To build mutual trust and assure you that we are a legitimate, reliable partner, we will establish weekly payments for your first two months of employment, transitioning to bi-weekly or monthly payments afterward based on your preference.



Growth Opportunity: While this role begins at 5–10 hours per week, there is a clear opportunity for your hours and responsibilities to scale as our systems grow and your integration with our workflows deepens.



HOW TO APPLY (READ CAREFULLY)



Because code quality, precision, and attention to detail are critical to this role, we use a strict screening process to filter out generic, copy-paste applications.



To apply, please reply via
 with the following exact subject line:

???? "I love clean SQL and Python workflows! Ready to optimize your systems."



In your application message, please answer these three questions:



N8N Experience: What is your experience level with N8N? Provide a brief description of a complex workflow or API integration you have successfully automated using N8N.



SQL Optimization: In your own words, what are the first three things you check when a client hands you a slow-running SQL query that is dragging down dashboard performance?



Refactoring Workflow: Tell me about a time you had to take over someone else’s unpolished code or quick prototype. What did you prioritize to turn it into production-ready software?



Please note: Shortlisted candidates will be invited to complete a short, paid test task (under 1 hour) to demonstrate SQL optimization and scripting standards.

title: Creative Strategist — Ecommerce
description:
About the company

We run a portfolio of accessory and jewelry e-commerce brands selling to Western markets (primarily Europe and North America). Our model is dropshipping-based — we source products, build brands around them, and scale them through paid social. We do 7 figures per year and are growing fast.

We're building a serious creative production operation and need someone who understands performance marketing, not just aesthetics.



The role

You will own the creative strategy for our video content. That means identifying winning angles, writing scripts and briefs, managing a small team of freelance videographers and editors, and making sure we ship 80–100 short-form video creatives per month consistently.

You will work directly with the founder. He sets the strategic direction and identifies angles to explore — you translate that into production-ready briefs and manage delivery end to end.



What you'll do

Spy on competitor ads (Meta Ad Library, TikTok Creative Center, Minea or AdSpy) and reverse-engineer winning angles

Define creative concepts and write clear scripts/briefs for each video format (UGC, b-roll, product close-up, testimonial, etc.)

Hit a consistent output of 80–100 video creatives per month across different formats and lengths

Stay current on AI-generated ad formats that are performing right now — you know what's working on Meta with AI creative and can brief accordingly

Track hook rate, hold rate, and CPA per creative — flag what's working, kill what's not

Report weekly to the founder: what went out, what's performing, what to scale or cut



What we're looking for



Non-negotiable:



2+ years of experience as a creative strategist or performance creative in e-commerce

Proven track record working with brands doing 6 or 7 figures/month — we'll ask for portfolio with metrics

Experience with jewelry, accessories, or identity-driven lifestyle products (fashion, beauty, etc.)

Your own network of reliable freelance creators and editors you've already worked with

Comfortable with AI-generated creative formats — you don't need to produce them yourself, but you know what AI ad formats are trending, what performs, and how to brief around them

You speak the language of paid social: hook rate, thumb-stop ratio, CTR, CPA — not just views and likes

You've managed creative production at volume — 50+ videos/month is not a new concept for you



Strong advantages:

Experience with Meta Ads and TikTok Ads specifically (not organic content)

Comfortable working directly with a founder and adapting fast

You've scaled a brand from scratch on paid social, not just managed existing accounts



This is NOT the right role if…

You come from branding or agency work and don't have direct paid social experience

You prefer to shoot and edit yourself rather than brief and manage others

You've never worked at volume or think 100 videos/month sounds unrealistic

Your portfolio is beautiful but you can't tell us what the hook rate or CPA was



How to apply

Send us the following — applications without these will not be reviewed:

A short intro: who you are, your background, and why this role fits you

2–3 examples of brands you've worked with + the results (revenue scale, ROAS, CPA improvement — real numbers)

Your current availability and preferred engagement (freelance rate or salary expectation)



We move fast. Strong applicants will hear back within 48 hours

title: Creative Strategist & Content Producer
description:
About the company

At Miraco Nutripharm, we are dedicated to advancing health & improving lives. Our goal is to relieve 1 billion people worldwide of pain & discomfort. If you know of anyone who has been worried about or suffered from any health problems, join us in making a positive impact by reducing the pain & distress others have to endure.

Job description

We're looking for a Creative Strategist & Content Producer to shape how our health & pharmaceutical brands communicate across both digital & offline channels. You'll craft effective strategies that translate scientific credibility into compelling storytelling & creative assets - helping us engage our diverse audience as we expand our presence regionally. 



The Creative Strategist & Content Producer will be the visionary link between our brand identity, compelling content creation & drive measurable performance across all key channels. This role is responsible for developing & testing high-impact creative strategies as well as producing content assets (visual, video, copy) internally, specifically designed to drive traffic, increase conversion rates, lower Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC) & drive overall revenue growth for our Shopify, Shopee & Lazada stores via social media as well as paid advertising platforms.



You'll work across multiple channels & markets to plan, create & optimize content that builds awareness, strengthens partnerships & supports the new channels of the business. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys balancing creativity, analytics & brand strategy in the health supplement industry. 



Key Responsibilities:

Creative Strategy

- Platform & Channel Strategy: Craft tailored creative strategies for B2C & B2B audiences optimized for platform-specific best practices & formats that align with brand goals & regulatory requirements in each market (e.g., Meta carousel ads, vertical video for TikTok/Reels, static product carousels for Shopee/Lazada e-commerce banner ads).

- Hypothesis Generation & A/B Testing: Develop robust creative testing matrices, formulate clear hypotheses for creative elements (hooks, calls-to-action, visual styles, copy length) that drive measurable improvements in Click-Through Rate (CTR) & Conversion Rate (CVR).

- Audience Segmentation: Translate target audience data & segmentation provided by media buyers into resonant creative themes, ensuring content speaks directly to different stages of the marketing funnel (awareness, consideration, conversion).

- Competitive Analysis: Continuously keep up to date with competitors & industry trends, identifying new & successful creative formats, hooks & messaging to finetune our strategy.

In-House Content Production & Execution 

- Performance Creative Development: Lead the end-to-end creative concept development & production for all organic & paid media campaigns (Meta, TikTok, Google/YouTube, etc.) that align with brand & campaign goals, focusing on high-volume, quick-turnaround testing required for performance marketing.

- Hands-on Asset Creation: Directly produce & edit native social content & performance ads using existing assets, stock libraries & internal resources. This includes:

i. Plan platform-specific content calendars: Cover educational, promotional & corporate communications

ii. Static/Image Editing: Adapt product photography, create ad variations & design simple graphics & banner ads

iii. Video Editing: Fast-paced assembly, cutting, adding text overlays, music & effects for short-form, vertical video (UGC-style, product demos, testimonials)

- Copywriting: Develop high-converting ad copy, landing page headlines & social media captions that align with the creative strategy & brand voice, with a focus on clear value propositions & strong CTAs.

- Asset Management: Ensure all campaign assets are correctly tagged, archived & deployed across relevant channels (Shopify, Shopee, Lazada store fronts & advertising platforms).

- Testing & Optimization: apply insights & analytics to refine & optimize content effectiveness across platforms.

Performance & Reporting

- Data-Driven Insights: Work closely with the Marketing Manager to analyze creative performance reports, identifying which creative variables are driving results (or failing) across Shopify, Shopee & Lazada traffic.

- Iteration & Optimization: 

i. Develop, adapt or review content & formats to improve engagement & performance

ii. Use performance data (ROAS, CPA, CTR, CVR) to rapidly iterate on existing creative assets & inform future strategy, ensuring a continuous cycle of improvement & optimization

Storefront Integration: Integrate winning creative messages & visuals onto the respective e-commerce storefronts (product pages, banners) to ensure a cohesive customer journey.

Multi-Channel Storytelling

- Content cohesion: Ensure content is aligned where possible across digital & print media, including LinkedIn, Instagram,
, YouTube, e-commerce platforms, brochures & trade materials.

- Tailor content: To achieve relevance & effectiveness across different stages of the audience journey — from brand awareness & education to conversion.

- Storytelling & visual consistency: To strengthen brand trust & recognition.

Compliance & Brand Integrity

- Uphold regulatory & ethical communication standards across all marketing activities.

- Ensure all content complies with regulatory guidelines & marketing requirements in each country we operate in, including product claims, advertising language & digital promotions.

- Maintain brand credibility by ensuring all communications are factual & aligned with company values.

- Collaborate with internal teams to review materials for accuracy, effectiveness & compliance before publication.



Requirements:

- 3–5 years of experience in creative strategy, content creation, social media, or brand marketing — ideally in health supplements, healthcare or wellness.

- Strong understanding of social media trends & platform best practices (Meta (FB/IG), LinkedIn, TikTok, YouTube, Google, Generative AI).

- Proficient in Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, Photoshop, Premiere Pro), CapCut, Canva, Figma, or similar tools.

- Excellent writing, editing & visual storytelling skills — adopt a strategic approach to design that integrates marketing & commercial goals.

- Excellent communication, project management & cross-functional collaboration skills.

- Familiarity with regulatory communication standards or track record in health supplements or healthcare industry is a plus.

title: Academic Legal Research and Writing Training Program  (Paid Nonprofit Learning Initiative and Academic Support)
description:
Academic Support and Learning Program



Paid Nonprofit Learning Initiative



Our church nonprofit is building a long term academic learning and program testing initiative for individuals who may later support nonprofit education, tutoring, guidance, and community based programs.



This is a paid remote learning program for applicants who enjoy studying, learning, writing, research, academic support work, and structured online learning.



This opportunity is for paid learning participants who want to grow in a school like learning environment while helping us test and develop academic programs for future nonprofit use.



Please Read Before Applying



Please read this full post carefully before applying.



We are busy church and nonprofit workers, so we are looking for applicants who can follow written instructions without asking many questions that are already answered in this post.



Please read the post more than once before applying. Do not apply if you are going to ask questions that are already answered here.



This is not a high paying opportunity. This is a paid learning and program testing initiative for people who genuinely enjoy studying, writing, research, and learning new things.



Please do not apply if:



• You do not read instructions carefully

• You cannot follow directions

• You are not qualified

• You are not familiar with Canvas or similar online learning platforms

• You are not familiar with Turnitin or originality review systems

• You are not comfortable with the honorarium budget

• You are not interested in learning or studying

• You are not willing to work in a structured academic environment

• You cannot communicate clearly and respectfully

• You cannot provide daily progress updates

• You cannot submit quality academic work

• You do not have reliable access to a computer and internet



This opportunity is best for someone who loves to study, enjoys learning new things, communicates well, writes clearly, and may later become a strong academic support person for nonprofit related programs.



Purpose of the Program



This nonprofit initiative helps us test, evaluate, and improve academic learning programs before they are used more broadly.



Participants will:



• Study assigned learning materials

• Complete structured academic modules

• Produce original written work and presentations

• Help evaluate program quality, clarity, difficulty, and structure

• Provide consistent progress updates

• Demonstrate reliability, discipline, and quality academic effort

• Work independently in a self paced online learning environment



This is a program testing and learning participant role.



Minimum Requirements



Applicants must meet the following requirements:



• Must be a college graduate

• Must have a good GPA or strong academic record

• Must provide proof of graduation

• Must provide diploma, certificate of graduation, or equivalent proof

• Must provide Transcript of Records or official school transcript

• Must have strong reading, writing, research, and study skills

• Must be very studious and able to learn independently

• Must be comfortable with self paced online learning

• Must be familiar with Canvas or similar online learning platforms

• Must be familiar with Turnitin or originality review systems

• Must be familiar with discussion boards and online course style learning

• Must know or be willing to follow APA academic writing format

• Must have regular access to a reliable PC or laptop

• Must have stable internet access

• Must be able to submit clean, organized, and quality academic work

• Must communicate consistently and provide progress updates



Who Should Apply



This opportunity is best for:



• College graduates with strong academic habits

• College degree holders with good academic records

• Straight A students or applicants with strong study discipline

• People who love to learn and study

• People who enjoy academic writing and research

• People who are organized and detail oriented

• People interested in tutoring, academic support, nonprofit work, or program testing

• People who can work independently without constant supervision

• People who are reliable, respectful, and serious about finishing what they start

• People who are available, responsive, and comfortable working online



Character and Reliability Required



Before anything else, character and reliability come first.



We carefully evaluate character during the first sessions. Many people may be intelligent or academically capable, but if we do not see reliability, respect, honesty, quality work, and strong work ethic early on, we will not be able to continue with that applicant.



We are looking for people who:



• Follow through on commitments

• Communicate respectfully

• Provide consistent progress updates

• Complete assignments they start

• Take responsibility seriously

• Stay responsive and professional

• Show honesty, discipline, and good character

• Take pride in producing clean and quality work

• Have strong study habits and academic discipline

• Learn well independently

• Care about details and accuracy



If an applicant stops responding, disappears, abandons work midway, submits careless work, or fails to communicate, the program will end for that applicant.



Our nonprofit depends on people who finish the work they start and care about the quality of what they submit.



About the Training Program



Participants will complete structured study modules and produce academic work.



The program includes:



• Research based paper

• PowerPoint presentations with speaker notes

• Organized written work based on assigned topics

• Proper citations and references

• Discussion board style learning activities when assigned

• Final capstone project



The program evaluates:



• Writing ability

• Research and analysis

• Communication

• Discipline and consistency

• Professionalism

• Integrity

• Ability to learn and follow instructions

• Quality of submitted work

• Attention to detail



This program is designed for applicants who enjoy studying and learning and want to strengthen their academic and professional skills.



Pay and Program Structure



• Honorarium ranges from PHP 4,500 for beginners to PHP 7,000 after passing the first stage per completed program

• Final honorarium may depend on the agreement, applicant qualifications, program track, work quality, and completion requirements

• Program includes 15 structured modules

• Program length is approximately 8 weeks

• Program is self paced and competency based

• Strong applicants often finish in about 7 weeks

• Payment is based on successful completion of the required program work

• Applicants must complete the full program requirements

• Poor quality, incomplete, careless, copied, or non original work will not be accepted



Each module requires:



• APA style essay

• PowerPoint presentation with speaker notes

• Proper citations and references

• Organized academic writing

• Original work

• Quality writing and clear presentation



Module 15 is the final capstone project.



Available Program Tracks



Applicants must choose one program track.



• Program A: Criminal Justice and Community Safety. Topics include justice systems, criminology, crime prevention, and community safety.

• Program B: Healthcare Administration and Community Health. Topics include healthcare systems, health policy, healthcare management, and community health programs.

• Program C: Nursing, Health Promotion, and Community Care. Topics include community health nursing, prevention strategies, patient education, and health promotion.

• Program D: United States Studies. Topics include United States history, society, culture, and civic institutions.

• Program E: Business and Administration. Topics include business writing, management, leadership, organizational behavior, marketing, business ethics, operations, and administration.

• Program F: Recreation, Tourism, and Hospitality. Topics include recreation management, tourism studies, hospitality service, event planning, customer experience, community recreation, and travel development.

• Program G: Law and Legal Studies. Topics include legal research, legal writing, case analysis, legal ethics, public policy, legal systems, and access to justice.



Academic Writing and Original Work Requirement



Academic writing in APA style is mandatory.



Applicants are expected to already be strong in:



• Writing

• Research

• Organization

• Citations

• Academic formatting

• Quality academic work



All work must be original and written by the applicant.



AI generated writing is not allowed.



AI tools may only be used for limited support, such as:



• Brainstorming

• Outlining

• Grammar review

• Study support



However:



• Copying is not allowed

• Plagiarism is not allowed

• AI generated submissions are not allowed

• Careless rewriting or copied content is not allowed

• Sources must be cited properly in APA style

• Originality checks may be used through Turnitin or similar review systems

• Work must be suitable for originality review because it is genuinely original, properly cited, and written honestly

• Applicants must submit only their own original work



We are looking for applicants who are genuinely good at academic work and can write, research, cite, organize, and present properly without depending on AI to do the work for them.



What This Can Lead To



Applicants who demonstrate strong work ethic, honesty, consistent performance, and quality work may be invited into ongoing paid work supporting our nonprofit programs.



We continue working only with people who show:



• Reliability

• Consistent communication

• Dependable work quality

• Professionalism

• Trustworthiness

• Respectful attitude

• Strong academic effort

• Careful and quality submissions



How to Apply



: 



Message also through WhatsApp if you receive no response:




Please include:



• Updated resume

• Full name and timezone

• Daily availability in hours per day

• Program choice A, B, C, D, E, F, or G

• Writing sample, 1 to 2 pages in APA style

• PowerPoint sample, 5 to 10 slides with speaker notes

• Confirmation statement below



Confirmation Statement



“I understand this is a nonprofit academic learning and program testing initiative. I understand that I must read and follow instructions carefully. I understand originality checks may be used. AI generated writing is not allowed. AI may only be used for limited assistance. I will submit only original work and include proper APA citations where required. I also understand that quality work, reliability, and consistent communication are required.”



Required documents:



• Resume or portfolio

• Proof of graduation

• School diploma, front and back

• Transcript of Records, front and back

• Proof of GPA or academic standing, if available



For nursing graduates, please also include if available:



• BSN diploma

• CHED verification of degree equivalency

• RN license copy



Qualified applicants may be invited for a phone interview.



Please read the full post carefully before asking questions already answered here.



Apply only if you are serious, studious, reliable, respectful, academically strong, familiar with Canvas and Turnitin, comfortable with the honorarium budget, and ready to complete quality academic work.

Academic Writing and Original Work Requirement

Join our team of A-players—if you’re one too, apply now!

mbers to the company’s standards and values.

PART-TIME Video Editor role (with the opportunity to move to full-time for the right candidate)



#What we are looking for#

Our high-priority tasks for this role include:



-Editing short-form video (Reels, TikTok, Shorts): hooks, captions, b-roll, music, brand templates

-Editing long-form video (YouTube, client interviews, property walkthroughs)

-Light ads and tech help: building and uploading ad creatives in Meta Ads Manager, and assisting inside GoHighLevel

-Confidently understanding spoken English instructions via videos and Zoom calls, and creating written SOPs

-Being adaptable and flexible in the tasks you complete within the agency



This job is for you if:

-You want to work in an environment where you are respected and treated fairly

-You pride yourself on being flexible and adaptable, and you are genuinely good with computers

-You cringe when you hear someone say something cannot be done

-You love learning new software and you find your own answers

-You welcome feedback and constructive criticism and look at them as an opportunity to get better

-You love staying organized and on top of your to-do list

-You want the freedom to take ownership of the role and to create your own best practices

-You enjoy finding solutions and love outside-of-the-box thinking

-You feel accomplished when your work is done to a high standard

-Most of all, a go-getter who wants an opportunity to grow into bigger roles as the agency grows



#First, let us talk about time expectations#

The hours can vary but you can expect 10 to 20 hours per week to start, growing for the right person. We work to Irish business hours (GMT), and you should be able to overlap for a daily check-in. From time to time we have tasks that need a quick turnaround, so some flexibility helps. This is a dynamic role with a daily check-in, not something scheduled far in advance.



#Now, let us talk about the awesome stuff#

-We have one policy. If you do the right thing by us, we will do the right thing by you.

-We are family first and we will do our absolute best to work around your needs. We understand that life can get in the way. ---All we ask is that you do not take advantage of this.

-We will always trust you until you give us a reason not to.

-You will never get in trouble or be reprimanded for an honest mistake, as long as you had our best interest at heart and thought it was the right decision.

-We actively encourage input. The worst case is a team of people too afraid to speak their piece.

-We are super transparent. If we are happy, you will know, and if we are not, you will know too.

-We are a fun, positive, growing team, and we love to support each other in our individual roles. We are like a virtual family.

-An opportunity to make a real difference. We are not churning and burning through clients, we want all of our team to be proud of where they work and the people they work for.

-We are big believers in hiring from the inside, so we actively encourage our team to look for opportunities to upskill.



#What you will be responsible for#

You will be the right-hand creative for our founder. Right now the agency is in a growth phase, and you will assist in producing the video and content that delivers results for clients.



Broad task 1: short-form video editing and repurposing

Broad task 2: long-form and property/listing video editing

Broad task 3: ad-creative production and Meta Ads Manager uploads

Broad task 4: GoHighLevel asset and funnel support, and writing simple SOPs



#Here is what we expect from you#

-As this is a remote position where we transfer large files back and forth, fast and reliable internet is a must.

-A capable computer, because editing is demanding.

-Nothing is ever a big enough problem that cannot be fixed if we are made aware of it. Disappearing when something goes wrong is a big no-no.

-You can understand and comprehend fluent spoken English, as all instructions and feedback are provided via Zoom and recorded video.

-You love getting things done. You keep your project board up to date and have high-touch communication, so we never have to track you down.

-You are a self-starter, problem-solver, and reliable. You can juggle lots of moving pieces and know how to focus and execute.

-You can bring ideas to the table and help drive the business forward.

-You love having full ownership over your work and constantly seek to improve it.

-You have high attention to detail and stay on brand, careful to avoid typos, without getting caught up in perfectionism.

-You are available and flexible Monday to Friday, with 10 to 20 hours per week to start.

-You are all about growth, and you can handle direct and blunt feedback for continuous improvement.

-You have a growth mindset and are open to participating in the online programs we provide.



#Application Details#

We will likely get 50+ applications for this role and we simply do not have time to interview that many, so make yours stand out if you want a role that can change the trajectory of your career.



This is a part-time job. Hours start at 10 to 20 per week and can grow as we scale. Compensation is USD $6 to $10 per hour depending on experience, with regular salary reviews.



This is a virtual role, so you can work from wherever is most comfortable. Be sure to tell us what rate you are looking for.

To prove you are detail-oriented and can follow a process, you must use the secret subject line for your application. It must include: I found my team



A short intro video is optional but will give you a big leg up. We are looking for personality over perfection. If you d
 not to send one, please tell us why.



Shortlisted applicants will receive a short follow-up message with a link to our application form, where you will upload your CV and a couple of quick screenshots.



Applications are due by [Friday, 19 June 2026], reviewed on a first come, first served basis.

title: Google Ads manager — Auckland Movers (part-time contractor)
description:
Hours: 3–5 per week

Goal: More quote completions within a fixed daily budget



What we're looking for

We run Google Search campaigns for Auckland Movers, a residential and commercial moving company. The account is working — conversion rate is around 6.87%, CPA is roughly NZ$76 on a $92/day budget. We want someone to push that further.



This isn't a maintenance role. If the current campaigns need restructuring, if there are ad groups worth adding, or if you think a new campaign type makes sense, make the case and run the test. We care about results. The existing setup is a starting point, not something to protect.



Current numbers



Right now: $92/day budget, ~6.87% conversion rate, ~NZ$76 CPA across two Search campaigns. Target is CPA under NZ$60 and conversion rate pushing toward 10%. 



Budget stays where it is until we can clearly see that more spend produces more quotes at a reasonable cost. Once we're there, that conversation happens quickly.



The work



Each week:



Review search terms, add negatives, cut spend that isn't converting

Adjust bids based on what's actually working

Short
 update: spend, conversions, CPA, what you changed and why



Each month:



Test ad copy — write new headlines, run them against current, cut the losers

Review how budget is split across campaigns

One-page summary: what moved, what didn't, what's next



As needed:



Propose new campaigns or restructures when you see an opportunity

Flag wasted spend before it runs long

Raise anything structural worth changing before the algorithm adapts to it

If you think
 Ads or 
 can drive more quotes cost-effectively, bring the proposal. We've underinvested in both. A past
 campaign ran at 0% conversion but we believe that was a tracking problem, not a channel problem. If you have a view on whether those channels are worth revisiting, we want to hear it.





How we work

 is the default. WhatsApp if something's urgent. A monthly call is available if you think it helps keep things aligned, but it's not required as long as the numbers are moving.



You get full editor access. Day-to-day optimisation is yours to make. Anything that changes overall budget or campaign strategy needs a quick sign-off first.



If you get the numbers moving, the scope grows with it. More campaigns, new channels, higher budget — that all gets scoped and paid separately. The base engagement is small by design. We grow it together once we can see the return.



What we need



3+ years managing Google Search for local or service businesses

A track record of actually lowering CPA, not just managing spend — bring a specific example

Strong negative keyword discipline (this is where most budgets bleed)

Comfortable with Smart Bidding and when tCPA makes sense vs when to hold off

Writes ad copy aimed at people likely to book, not just anyone searching

Useful but not required: experience with home services or trades in NZ or AU. Familiarity with GA4 conversion tracking is a plus — we've had tracking issues in the past and want someone who notices that kind of thing early.



To apply



Send an
 with:



One account you improved — what CPA looked like when you started, what you got it to, and the main things you changed

Your rate for roughly 4 hours per week

When you can start

One thing worth thinking about before you apply: given a 6.87% CVR on Maximize Conversions with a $92/day budget, what would your first two weeks look like?

The Opportunity:**



This is a pivotal part-time role for an "Operations & Scheduling Coordinator" who will be instrumental in ensuring our operations run smoothly and efficiently. You will manage crucial administrative tasks, coordinate scheduling, and maintain our business systems, directly contributing to our service delivery excellence. If you are operations-minded, technically savvy, and thrive in an autonomous role where you can make a real impact, we encourage you to apply!



---



**Your Responsibilities:**



As our Virtual Operations & Scheduling Coordinator, you will be instrumental in:



*   Preparing and managing client quotes accurately, including detailed technical and job-specific information.

*   Strategically scheduling jobs to minimise technician travel time, utilizing your knowledge (or ability to quickly learn) of our service-area geography.

*   Maintaining and updating our core business systems (GoHighLevel, ServiceMATE, Xero) to ensure data integrity and operational efficiency.

*   Accurately recording referral sources for every new client within our service software.

*   Answering and directing incoming customer calls professionally via the C3X phone system.

*   Ensuring daily operations run smoothly and effectively with minimal supervision.



---

We're searching for someone who possesses:



*   An operations-minded approach, coupled with strong technical aptitude and exceptional attention to detail.

*   A background in engineering, project management, or trades coordination is a strong advantage.

*   The ability to quickly learn and apply service-area geography for highly efficient scheduling.

*   Excellent verbal and written English communication skills.

*   Comfort working autonomously and adapting to a flexible management style.

*   Availability to work part-time hours aligned with Australian business hours (with some flexibility on the exact start time).

*   Familiarity with GoHighLevel, ServiceMATE, Xero, or similar business management tools is a significant advantage (comprehensive training will be provided for all systems).



---

title: Marketing Coordinator
description:
Please note: This is a hands-on marketing role, not a general administrative or virtual assistant position. We're specifically looking for candidates with experience in content marketing, thought leadership, event/tradeshow coordination,
 campaigns, partner marketing, and marketing execution. If your background is primarily administrative support without direct ownership of marketing initiatives, this role is unlikely to be a fit.



Uncap | A Shopify Platinum Partner



Location: Full-time · Remote

Working Hours: 8:00 AM - 4:00 PM EST (8:00 PM - 4:00 AM PH time)





About Uncap

Founded in 2014 in Chicago, Illinois, Uncap is a design and development agency specializing in Shopify and Shopify Plus solutions. We partner with brands across a wide range of industries to build, optimize, and scale their eCommerce operations through strategic design, development, and managed services. With a fully remote team spanning the United States, the Philippines, and India, we bring global expertise and collaborative support to every client engagement.





The Role



As our Marketing Coordinator, you'll help bring marketing campaigns to life—from content distribution and
 marketing to event execution and partner co-marketing initiatives. You'll coordinate campaign assets, manage publishing schedules, support webinar and tradeshow planning, oversee booth logistics and follow-up activities, and help ensure marketing efforts contribute to lead generation and pipeline growth. This role is best suited for someone who understands marketing workflows and enjoys turning plans into execution.



Key Responsibilities



- Brand & Content Execution: Manage the content calendar end-to-end, including drafting, scheduling, publishing, and repurposing content across our LinkedIn, website, and
. You will maintain strict brand consistency according to the Atlas design system.

- Social & Thought Leadership Cadence: Operate the publishing engine for our leadership team (CEO & Managing Director), including ghostwriting/editing content, scheduling posts, and reporting on engagement.

- Event & Tradeshow Coordination: Own the marketing execution for key events (e.g., B2B Online, executive dinners, sponsorships). This involves booth presence, collateral, pre-show outreach support, on-site content capture, and post-show follow-up content. You will coordinate logistics with the Executive Assistant and track ROI inputs with the Sales team.

- Case Study & Launch Collateral: Produce client case studies and launch announcements. This requires interviewing the delivery team, drafting the narrative, partnering with the brand designer on design, publishing, and feeding materials to sales.

- Shopify Co-marketing & Partner Presence: Coordinate joint activity with the Shopify partner team, ensure our partner directory listing is optimized and current, and manage marketing-related website fixes.



What You'll Deliver



- Consistent content output per week (e.g., 3–5 LinkedIn posts + 1 long-form/month).

- Case studies shipped per quarter (e.g., 2/quarter).

- Positive trend in LinkedIn impressions and engagement (MoM).

- Events executed on time and on budget per quarter.

- Post-event follow-up content/sequences live within 72 hours of show close (to support Sales' 3x ROI clock).

- Inbound leads or MQLs attributed to marketing (once tracking is established).



Requirements



- 2–4 years of experience in marketing, content, or comms (B2B, SaaS, or agency experience preferred).

- Strong writer: able to take technical work from a delivery team and translate it into clean, confident, client-facing narratives.

- Proven experience with event/tradeshow coordination, covering booth logistics, collateral, and follow-up sequences.

- Comfortable working across key platforms: LinkedIn,
 marketing tools, a CMS, and project management software (we use ClickUp).

- Basic design fluency (Canva/Figma) and capable of working effectively alongside a dedicated brand designer.

- Self-directed, highly organized, and committed to shipping consistently on a set cadence.

- Comfortable using AI tools day-to-day—prompting LLMs for research, personalization, and copywriting



Nice to Have



- Familiarity with the Shopify/ecommerce ecosystem.

- Experience in partner/channel co-marketing.

- Light analytics experience (LinkedIn, GA4).





Please include your LinkedIn NAME with your application. This helps us identify applicants who have read the full job description.

title: Video Editor – Shorts, Long-Form and Trailers DaVinci Resolve
description:

You'll edit across three formats:



Short-form clips - Reels, TikToks, Shorts. Finding the best 
nts, crafting hooks, making videos people actually watch.



Long-form episodes - Full podcast edits. Pacing, cuts, audio polish, making hour-long conversations feel tight.



Trailers - Cinematic, high-energy promotional videos (think Diary Of A CEO style). These need real editing chops - dramatic pacing, music, powerful 
nts strung together.



Design matters here. Your videos need to look polished - title cards, captions, graphics, layouts. If you don't have a good eye for design, this role will frustrate you.



This role is right for you if you:



- Are always learning - you seek out new techniques, watch breakdowns, stay curious

- Can edit both quick social clips AND polished long-form content

- Get excited about creating trailers that give people chills

- Have a sharp eye for 
nts that will hit

- Care about design - your captions, titles, and graphics look intentional, not default

- Can work fast without dropping quality

- Take pride in clean, polished edits



The Right Person Will:

- Have a strong portfolio showing range - short-form clips, long-form edits, and ideally trailers or promo videos (no portfolio, no consideration)

- Have a good eye for design - your title cards, captions, and graphics look polished, not like default templates

- Be a genuine learner - you actively improve your skills, seek feedback, and stay on top of what's working

- Know DaVinci Resolve well - multi-cam, colour correction, proxies, basic audio in Fairlight

- Have motion graphics skills - we use Fusion inside Resolve, but After Effects experience transfers (you can learn Fusion quickly)

- Understand short-form trends: hooks, pacing, captions, what works on TikTok/Reels/Shorts

- Know how to edit for emotion - trailers require pacing, music selection, and building to 
nts

- Care about details - no sloppy captions, no audio issues, no "good enough"

- Be a self-starter who manages their own time and hits deadlines

- Stay organized when handling lots of source files and outputs

- Communicate clearly in English (written and spoken)

- Be comfortable with cloud tools and open to AI workflows (transcription, clip finding)

- (Bonus) Have a genuine interest in podcasts or content creation

- (Bonus) Familiar with Figma, Photoshop, Canva, or other design tools for graphics/thumbnails



What You'll Do:



Short-Form Clips:

- Watch long-form podcasts and find the best 
nts for clips

- Edit vertical videos with strong hooks, good pacing, captions, graphics, music, and sound effects

- Keep turnaround times fast while maintaining quality

- Adapt style for different platforms and client brands



Long-Form Episodes:

- Edit full podcast episodes - pacing, cuts, removing dead air, keeping energy up

- Handle multi-cam footage, sync audio/video, colour correction

- Create and work with proxy files for efficient workflows

- Polish audio and ensure consistent levels throughout



Trailers & Promos:

- Create cinematic trailers that build excitement for episodes or shows

- Select the most powerful 
nts and string them together with music and pacing

- Edit for emotion - know when to hit hard and when to breathe
