title: Junior Developer - AI-Augmented Product & Tooling Team
description:
USD Pay · Long-Term · Philippines



What We're Building



We build AI-powered consumer products, custom developer tooling, and client solutions across multiple verticals:

AI image and video generation — a mobile and web app that transforms photos into stylized artwork using generative AI. Single Flutter codebase, Firebase backend, multiple AI model integrations.



Game development — interactive experiences with structured world-building and AI-assisted content generation.



Prompt research and skills tooling — we built a package manager for AI agent prompts and skills that detects your repo's tech stack and ranks results accordingly. We research how prompts perform across different models, build reusable skill packages that any AI coding agent can load, and maintain a catalog of 30+ skills covering everything from security review to prompt quality self-assessment. This isn't a side project — it's a core product.



MCP and agent workflow research — we actively research and build integrations using the Model Context Protocol (MCP) and other emerging standards that reduce friction between developers and AI agents. We've built coordination servers that let multiple agents reserve files, message each other, and avoid conflicts. We've built tmux-based orchestration so developers can run 3-5 AI agents in parallel. When a new protocol, tool, or workflow pattern emerges, we evaluate it against real work and adopt or build what's missing.



Code quality tooling for agentic development — AI agents write a lot of code fast. The bottleneck isn't speed, it's confidence. We built compiler-integrated mutation testing and code quality metrics in Rust and TypeScript — tools that use each language's native AST parser so agents and developers can trust that generated code actually works. These aren't standalone research projects; they're the quality backbone that makes high-velocity agentic development safe.

Infrastructure and DevOps — Kubernetes clusters, CI/CD pipelines, private networking, infrastructure-as-code across all projects.



How We Work

We follow a pattern that defines the team culture: see a gap ? research what's available ? build it or adopt the best option ? ship it ? share it with the team.

We needed mutation testing tuned to our languages — generic linters couldn't handle Rust's error propagation or TypeScript's union types correctly. So we built compiler-integrated tools that use each language's native AST parser. We needed AI coding agents to coordinate without stepping on each other's files. So we built an MCP coordination server and a tmux orchestrator. We needed an issue tracker that works inside AI agent sessions. So we ported an open-source one to Rust and integrated it into the workflow. We needed to understand why some prompts waste tokens and others don't. So we built a prompt quality analyzer that extracts your messages from session logs, rates them, and shows you exactly where you're losing efficiency.



A new AI model drops on OpenRouter — by the end of the week, someone on the team has tested it against our workflow and reported back. A new MCP server appears on GitHub — someone's already evaluated whether it solves a real problem for us. A new 
 tool shows up on
 — someone's tried it in a real session. This isn't a scheduled R&D activity. It's how the team operates.



The internal tools are mostly Rust and Go. The products are Flutter and TypeScript. Client work varies — we recently picked up a Drupal project, and the expectation was that the team could ramp on an unfamiliar framework in a day using AI-assisted exploration. That's the skill we hire for.



What Makes This Team Different

Every developer works alongside AI coding agents as core workflow — not as an experiment. You'll have:

5 AI coding runtimes at your workstation (Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, OpenCode, Cursor)

30+ custom agent skills covering security, testing, architecture, code review, and prompt quality analysis

Multi-agent coordination via MCP so you can run several AI assistants on different tasks simultaneously without file conflicts

Automated quality gates (mutation testing, code metrics, security scanning, bug scanning) that give you confidence in AI-generated code before it hits review



Prompt research tools that help you measure and improve how effectively you communicate with AI agents

We don't just use these tools. We build them, research the protocols behind them, improve them, and expect every developer to have opinions about what works and what doesn't.

What We Expect From You



You experiment before you're told to. When a new AI model, CLI tool, MCP server, or workflow appears — on
, Hacker News, a 
, wherever — your instinct is to install it and try it. Not bookmark it. Not wait for a tea
eting. Try it, form a view, share what you found.



You assess your own work. We have tools that analyze prompt quality, code review effectiveness, and development patterns. You're expected to run them on yourself, identify your own anti-patterns, and fix them. Nobody will chase you to do this.

You learn by doing, not by reading. Our onboarding gives you access to the full environment on day one. We expect you to explore it. Open things, break things, ask questions when you're stuck — but try first. If we hand you a framework you've never seen before, the expectation is that you and your AI agents figure it out together — fast.



You communicate early, not late. Blocked for 30 minutes? Say something. Found a problem nobody mentioned? Flag it. A process doesn't make sense? Push back. Silence is the only wrong answer.



You follow through. When you pick up a task, you own it until it's done — including tests, docs, and letting the team know it's complete.



What the Work Looks Like

Build and ship features in Flutter (Dart) and Firebase Functions (TypeScript)

Contribute to internal Rust and Go tooling as you grow into the stack

Research and evaluate new AI models, MCP integrations, and developer tools

Integrate AI models for image generation, video generation, and content moderation

Pick up unfamiliar frameworks for client projects using AI-assisted exploration

Conduct peer reviews that actually catch problems — not rubber stamps

Evaluate new tools, models, and workflows as they emerge and share findings with the team

Run self-assessments on your development practices and discuss results at standups

Improve the team's engineering standards — our docs are living documents, not commandments



Tech Stack

Products:

Flutter (Dart) — iOS, Android, web from one codebase

Firebase Functions Gen 2, Node.js 25, TypeScript

Firestore, Cloud Storage, Stripe

OpenAI API, Google Gemini, Vision API



Internal Tooling:

Rust — mutation testing, code quality metrics, issue tracking, bug scanning

Go — AI skill package management, multi-agent orchestration, MCP coordination servers

Infrastructure:

Kubernetes, Forgejo (self-hosted git), Jenkins CI/CD

Ansible, OpenTofu, Semaphore, SAST/DAST and other security tooling

Lefthook, oxlint, Prettier, Spectral, Checkov, gitleaks, semgrep



You don't need to know all of this on day one. You need to be the kind of person who starts exploring it on day one.

Schedule



The team currently works 4pm–12am PHT (Manila time), but other schedules overlapping with US Eastern business hours can also be accommodated. We work this window as a team. As we grow, we plan to introduce flexible scheduling as additional teams are creating with other schedules.



Compensation

We're a bootstrapped startup pre-launch, looking for junior developers who are hungry to build real skills on real products. Starting compensation is junior-rate USD, paid via OnlineJobs.ph / Payoneer. Compensation scales once we launch and have revenue — early tea
mbers who prove themselves will be first in line for increases.



What you get:

Production experience shipping AI consumer products with professional engineering practices

Daily hands-on experience with AI coding tools and internal Rust/Go tooling most developers never touch

Exposure to prompt engineering research, MCP integrations, and agent workflow design

Direct mentorship on a small team — no layers between you and decisions

USD income with growth tied directly to company growth

A real voice in how the team works and what tools we build next



How to Apply

Step 1: Pick any AI coding tool you haven't used before — Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, RooCode, Kiro, GitHub Copilot, anything. Spend 30 minutes using it on a small task (a personal project, a tutorial, a three.js game, a port of a popular utility into Rust, a throwaway script — doesn't matter).

Step 2: Send your application with:

What you built with the AI tool — what you tried, what surprised you, whether you'd use it again. A few sentences is fine. We don't care which tool or whether you liked it. We care that you tried it and formed a view.

A project you've built that you're proud of (link or description)

Your experience with Flutter, TypeScript, Rust or similar

Your availability (full-time or part-time)

Your expected monthly rate (USD)

mbers when appropriate.

Closing and Diligence Support

• Support the handoff process to legal, finance, or transaction teams once a prospect becomes serious.

Sales and Follow-Up Discipline

s, manage rejection, and follow up consistently.

Real Estate and Capital Markets Knowledge

Organization and CRM Management

title: Part-Time Social Media, Community & Content Assistant
description:
Part-Time Social Media, Community & Content Assistant

Remote | Philippines-based preferred | Fragrance Brand / Cat Social Media





About the Brand

Soki London is an independent British perfume brand founded by fragrance creator and YouTuber Sophie King. We create long-lasting, feminine, story-led fragrances inspired by powerful female characters, travel, romance and modern femininity.

The brand has an active social media community across Instagram, TikTok and YouTube, with regular comments, customer engagement and a growing audience. We are looking for a reliable, creative and detail-oriented Social Media, Community & Content Assistant to help manage comments, create and post engaging short-form content, support content engagement, and assist with YouTube thumbnail and title testing.

This is a part-time remote role, ideal for someone based in the Philippines with strong written English, good attention to detail, and experience supporting beauty, fashion, lifestyle, ecommerce or creator-led brands.

Role Overview

You will help keep the Soki London community engaged by replying to comments, identifying content opportunities, creating and posting short-form content for TikTok and Instagram, and supporting basic YouTube optimisation tasks.

The role includes both community management and content support. You will be given brand guidelines, approved reply templates, product information, FAQs, content examples, raw footage, product imagery, brand assets and examples of Sophie’s tone of voice.

You should be warm, careful, organised, proactive and creative, with a good understanding of TikTok and Instagram trends.

Key Responsibilities

1. Instagram Comment Management

You will help manage comments on Soki London & SokiCats Instagram posts, reels and ads.

Replying to customer comments using approved brand tone and templates.

Liking positive comments.

Thanking customers for compliments and feedback.

Answering simple product questions, such as where to buy the perfumes, sample availability, fragrance notes, travel spray size, vegan and cruelty-free status, £5 sample voucher information and stock availability.

Flagging comments that need Sophie’s personal reply.

Flagging complaints, order issues, allergy/ingredient questions, press enquiries, influencer requests or retailer enquiries.

Saving strong customer comments or testimonials for future marketing use.

Tracking repeated questions that could become future content ideas.

2. TikTok Comment Management

You will help monitor and reply to TikTok comments on Soki London & SokiCats videos.

Replying to comments in a friendly, conversational tone.

Encouraging customers to try samples where relevant.

Answering simple product or scent questions.

Flagging comments that may be suitable for “reply with video” content.

Identifying comments that show strong purchase intent.

Noting recurring questions, objections or product requests.

Liking positive comments.

Escalating negative comments, complaints or sensitive questions.

3. Viral TikTok & Instagram Content Creation

You will help create short-form video content for TikTok and Instagram Reels using existing Soki London & SokiCats assets, product imagery, raw footage, founder content, customer comments, trends and approved brand messaging.

Creating TikTok videos and Instagram Reels using provided photos, videos, product clips and brand assets.

Editing short-form videos in CapCut, Canva, TikTok editor, Instagram editor or similar tools.

Turning customer comments into content ideas.

Creating “reply to comment” style video concepts.

Repurposing YouTube clips into TikTok and Instagram Reels.

Identifying trending TikTok and Instagram sounds that are suitable for a beauty/fragrance brand.

Creating simple, engaging hooks for videos.

Adding captions, subtitles and on-screen text.

Creating videos around product benefits, including long-lasting perfumes, £5 samples with £5 voucher, best perfumes for summer, bridal perfumes, compliment-getting scents, perfume layering, travel sprays, founder-led behind-the-scenes content, fragrance personality quizzes, customer reviews and testimonials.

Suggesting content ideas based on current social trends.

Creating simple “viral-style” videos that feel native to TikTok and Instagram rather than overly polished adverts.

Testing different hooks, formats, captions and calls to action.

Tracking which content performs best and suggesting more of what is working.

4. TikTok & Instagram Posting

You will schedule and post approved content to TikTok and Instagram.

Uploading approved videos to TikTok and Instagram Reels.

Writing captions in the Soki London tone of voice.

Adding relevant hashtags.

Adding product tags or links where instructed.

Selecting suitable cover images.

Checking that captions, tags and links are correct before posting.

Posting at agreed times.

Monitoring early engagement after posting.

Reporting which posts perform best.

Keeping a content tracker updated with post date, caption, platform, link, views, likes, comments, saves and shares.

Ensuring all content is approved before posting until trust and brand understanding are fully established.

5. YouTube Comment Management

You will help manage comments on Sophie’s YouTube videos, including perfume review content and Soki London brand content.

Replying to recent YouTube comments using approved guidelines.

Liking or hearting positive comments where appropriate.

Flagging thoughtful comments that may need Sophie’s personal response.

Answering simple Soki London product questions.

Directing viewers to samples or the website where appropriate.

Identifying frequently asked questions.

Highlighting potential video ideas based on viewer comments.

Keeping track of common fragrance topics viewers are asking about.

Escalating anything sensitive, negative, controversial or requiring personal input.

6. YouTube Thumbnail & Title A/B Testing Support

You will assist with basic YouTube optimisation by helping test and track video titles and thumbnails.

Uploading or setting up alternate thumbnails when instructed.

Recording thumbnail/title tests in a tracking sheet.

Monitoring performance before and after changes.

Tracking metrics such as click-through rate, views, watch time, average view duration and impressions.

Helping compare which title or thumbnail performs better.

Suggesting title variations based on existing video themes and keywords.

Suggesting thumbnail text options.

Checking competitor or similar perfume videos for title inspiration.

Reporting results clearly each week.

You do not need to be a YouTube expert, but you should be comfortable using YouTube Studio and tracking results carefully.

7. Weekly Reporting

Each week, you will provide a short report covering:

Number of Instagram comments replied to.

Number of TikTok comments replied to.

Number of YouTube comments replied to.

TikTok and Instagram content created.

TikTok and Instagram content posted.

Best-performing posts.

Worst-performing posts.

Trends or sounds worth using.

Most common customer questions.

Any complaints or issues to review.

Any influencer, press or retail enquiries.

Best customer comments/testimonials.

Suggested content ideas from comments.

Thumbnail/title tests currently running.

Thumbnail/title test results.

What You Should Escalate

Please do not reply independently to:

Customer complaints.

Missing orders, shipping problems or refund requests.

Ingredient safety questions.

Allergy or medical questions.

Legal, regulatory or compliance questions.

Retailer or distributor enquiries.

Press enquiries.

Influencer collaboration requests.

Negative comments that could become sensitive.

Anything involving Sophie personally.

Anything you are unsure about.

Instead, flag these clearly for review.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal person will have:

Excellent written English.

Experience replying to social media comments for a brand, creator or ecommerce business.

Experience creating TikTok videos and Instagram Reels.

Good understanding of TikTok and Instagram trends.

Ability to edit simple short-form videos.

Experience with CapCut, Canva (We can provide access), TikTok editor, Instagram editor or similar.

A warm, friendly and natural writing style.

Good attention to detail.

An understanding of beauty, fragrance, fashion or lifestyle brands.

Ability to follow brand tone of voice.

Ability to work independently and ask questions when unsure.

Experience with Instagram, TikTok and YouTube.

Basic experience with YouTube Studio is a bonus.

Experience with Shopify or ecommerce customer questions is a bonus.

Reliable internet connection.

Good organisation and communication skills.

Brand Tone of Voice

Soki London’s tone is:

Warm.

Feminine.

Helpful.

Founder-led.

Elegant but not overly formal.

Excited but not pushy.

Friendly and conversational.

Confident but never arrogant.

The tone should feel like a helpful beauty founder or trusted fragrance friend.

Avoid language that feels robotic, overly corporate, spammy, generic or too sales-focused.

Example Comment Replies

Comment: “Which one is best for summer?”

Reply/Action: “Aphrodite is our most tropical summer scent — it has mango, lotus flower, palm leaves and coconut milk, so it feels really fresh and sun-kissed.”

Comment: “Do you do samples?”

Reply/Action: “Yes, we do £5 samples, and each one comes with a £5 digital voucher you can use towards any future purchase.”

Comment: “Is this vegan?”

Reply/Action: “Yes, Soki London fragrances are vegan and cruelty-free.”

Comment: “I don’t know which one to choose.”

Reply/Action: “Aphrodite is tropical and joyful, Cleopatra is sensual and bridal, Empress is fruity and gourmand, Artemis is woody and elegant, and Ophelia is fresh, clean and floral.”

Comment: “My order hasn’t arrived.”

Reply/Action: Action: Do not reply with a full answer. Flag to Sophie/customer service.

Example Content Ideas

The person in this role may help create content such as:

“POV: you finally find a perfume that actually lasts.”

“Which Soki London perfume are you?”

“Perfumes for the girl who wants to smell expensive.”

“The bridal perfume I created for my own wedding.”

“A £5 perfume sample that gives you a £5 voucher.”

“If you like tropical perfumes, try Aphrodite.”

“If you want a clean girl floral, try Ophelia.”

“Perfumes that feel like main character energy.”

“Customer comments that made our day.”

“Pack an order with me.”

“Behind the scenes of an independent perfume brand.”

“Three perfumes for three different moods.”

“Perfume layering ideas with Soki London travel sprays.”

Hours & Availability

This is a part-time remote role.

Expected hours: 10–15 hours per week to start, with the opportunity to increase if the role goes well.

Preferred availability:

Check comments at least once per working day.

Create and/or schedule several short-form videos per week.

Provide a short weekly report.

Be available for occasional updates or instructions via
, Slack, WhatsApp, Trello or Asana.

Trial Task

As part of the application process, please complete the following tasks:

Comment Reply Task

Please reply to the following sample comments in the Soki London tone of voice:

“Which perfume lasts the longest?”

“Do you have samples?”

“Is Cleopatra good for a wedding?”

“Where can I buy this?”

“I love the bottle, it’s so pretty!”

“What does Ophelia smell like?”

“Is this cruelty free?”

“I’m not sure whether to get Aphrodite or Empress.”

“Can influencers work with you?”

“My order hasn’t arrived yet.”

Content Idea Task

Please suggest:

5 TikTok/Reel ideas for Soki London.

3 opening hooks for a video about long-lasting perfume.

3 opening hooks for a video about £5 samples.

3 caption ideas for a TikTok about Cleopatra as a bridal perfume.

3 trending-style video formats you think would work for a perfume brand.



How to Apply

Please apply with:

A short introduction.

Your relevant experience.

Examples of brands, creators or social media accounts you have supported.

Examples of TikToks, Reels or short-form videos you have created.

Your hourly rate.

Your availability per week.

The tools you use for editing content.

Your answers to the trial task above.

Experience with beauty, fragrance, fashion, lifestyle, ecommerce or YouTube creators is preferred.

title: SEO Content QA Specialist (VA) — Remote
description:
I run a small, established SEO agency for local businesses in Australia, and I'm looking for someone with a sharp eye to join me on a project basis to start, with a clear path to something long-term for the right person.



THE ROLE



Our content process is heavily AI-assisted. That means the role isn't writing from a blank page, it's quality control: taking AI-generated content and making it genuinely client-ready.



Here's the core of it: your job is to make everything perfect before it reaches me. I'm the final glance, not the proofreader. By the time work lands on my desk, it should already be right, polished, accurate, client-ready. Nothing obviously off, nothing half-checked.



Day to day, that means:



- Proofreading and editing AI-written content to a high standard

- Tailoring content so it actually fits each client, not just generic output 9You'll be responsible for intimately understanding each business we work with and tailor content for them)

- Checking SEO keyword inclusions read naturally and aren't forced or janky

- Preparing client-facing report documents that require careful, accurate editing

- Some Google business Profile work



This is detail work, and the detail is the deliverable. The single most important trait is a keen eye: catching the things that are obviously off and self-checking your own work before you hand it over, every time.



WHO THIS IS FOR



- You have a background in copywriting and understand what good SEO-optimised content looks like

- You're comfortable using AI tools day to day (we use Claude heavily, including Claude skills, so genuine confidence here matters)

- You're tech-comfortable and can follow a process without needing hand-holding on every step

- You work autonomously. I hire people because they're skilled enough to do the work on their own. We have training and SOPs for exactly that reason.

- You know when to reach out if something's unclear, rather than handing in work that misses the mark



THE SETUP



- Fully remote, with genuine freedom over when you work. Time is tracked, but you're not clocking in and out to set hours. It's self-paced

- A lot of trust is placed on you to do high-quality work independently

- This starts as a single project and will likely be intensive up front. If it goes well, I'll be inviting you to stay on, first part-time, then into a well-paid full-time position



If you're someone looking to prove yourself and earn a great long-term role, this is that opportunity. 



TO APPLY



Send me your enquiry with a bit of your background and your availability.

title: Inbox Manager
description:
Are you the person who keeps the inbox from becoming chaos?



Do you notice the difference between a real prospect reply, an out-of-office, a referral, a bounce, and someone politely saying "not now"? Do you like clear rules, clean labels, organized CRM records, and fast follow-up?



If you are careful, responsive, and genuinely enjoy making sure every message gets handled the right way, this may be a strong fit.



Why this role exists



We run outbound campaigns for B2B service companies. When prospects reply, those replies need to be read, categorized, answered, logged, and followed up quickly. If that workflow gets sloppy, good leads get missed and client reporting becomes unreliable.



We are hiring an Inbox Manager to own that daily response workflow. You will not be expected to design strategy or close deals. Your job is to keep the response engine clean, fast, and accurate.



This role is opening because one of our current tea
mbers is changing schedules, and we need dedicated coverage for inbox work.



Why work with us



- Fully remote contractor role with clear SOPs and a defined workflow

- Direct support from leadership during training

- Long-term opportunity for someone who is reliable and precise

- Work that rewards consistency, judgment, and careful communication

- Clear expectations and measurable performance standards

- A team that cares about clean systems and fast execution



What you'll be doing



Daily Inbox Triage

- Monitor campaign inboxes during the agreed coverage window.

- Separate warmup
s, bounces, out-of-office replies, unsubscribe requests, neutral replies, positive replies, referrals, bid requests, and call-booking opportunities.

- Apply the correct labels/dispositions so reporting stays accurate.

- Escalate hot leads, bid requests, and unclear cases quickly.



Replies and Follow-Up

- Use approved response templates and edit them so they sound natural and address the prospect's actual message.

- Reply within the required SLA during coverage hours.

- Schedule send-later replies when a prospect is outside their business hours.

- Create follow-up tasks when a reply needs future action.

- Make sure no real lead is left without a next step.



CRM Hygiene

- Add or update contacts in OutreachSphere Direct CRM when the SOP requires it.

- Include all relevant contacts on a thread, including CC'd referrals when appropriate.

- Keep tags, contact details, notes, and next steps accurate.

- Process unsubscribes, undeliverables, and do-not-contact requests same business day.



You'll crush this role if you...



- Are fast, careful, and responsive during your working hours

- Write clear professional English without sounding robotic

- Naturally organize information and follow checklists

- Can make good judgment calls when a reply is ambiguous

- Are comfortable using templates while still personalizing the final message

- Have experience with inbox management, CRM updates, sales support, customer support, or lead follow-up

- Are honest when you are unsure and escalate instead of guessing

- Like repetitive operational work and find satisfaction in getting it right every time

- Can learn tools like Missive, Smartlead, GoHighLevel, or similar CRMs



This role is not for you if...



- You want a creative strategy role

- You get bored by repetitive queue work

- You are slow to respond during your working hours

- You dislike detailed labeling, CRM updates, or process documentation

- You improvise instead of following approved templates and rules

- You need someone checking on you constantly to stay on task

- Written English is difficult for you



HOW TO APPLY



Submit your application here: 



The application takes about 10 minutes and includes a short personalized video. Applications without a video submission will not be reviewed.



Strong candidates will hear from us within 24 hours.

title: Law JD Graduate Academic Support - Paid to study
description:
Paid Nonprofit Learning Initiative



Law Program Testing and Academic Participant



Our church nonprofit is developing law related academic learning programs that may later support tutoring, guidance, legal education support, nonprofit training, and community based educational services.



We are selecting qualified law graduates, JD graduates, LLB graduates, or applicants with strong legal education backgrounds for paid remote pilot programs.



This opportunity is for people who genuinely enjoy studying law, reading cases, legal writing, legal research, structured online learning, and academic work.



This is not a high paying position. It is best for someone who wants to learn, review law related materials, strengthen academic skills, test structured learning programs, and possibly grow into future nonprofit support work.



This is a good side opportunity for someone who loves learning, is very studious, can work independently, follows instructions carefully, and has regular access to a reliable computer.



Please Read Before Applying



Please read this full post carefully before applying.



We are busy church and nonprofit workers, so we are looking for applicants who can follow written instructions without asking many questions that are already answered in this post.



Please read the post more than once before applying.



Do not apply if you are going to ask questions that are already answered here.



Please do not apply if:



• You do not read instructions carefully

• You cannot follow directions

• You are not qualified

• You are not a law graduate or do not have strong proof of legal education

• You are not familiar with Canvas or similar online learning platforms

• You are not familiar with Turnitin or originality review systems

• You are not comfortable with the honorarium budget

• You are not interested in studying law or legal systems

• You are not willing to work in a structured academic environment

• You cannot communicate clearly and respectfully

• You cannot provide daily progress updates

• You cannot submit quality legal academic work

• You do not have reliable access to a computer and internet



Purpose of the Initiative



This nonprofit initiative is designed to help us test, evaluate, and improve law related academic learning programs before they are used more broadly.



Participants will:



• Study assigned law related learning materials

• Complete structured academic modules

• Produce original written work and presentations

• Help evaluate program quality, clarity, difficulty, and structure

• Provide consistent progress updates

• Demonstrate reliability, discipline, and quality academic effort

• Work independently in a self paced online learning environment



This is a law program testing and learning participant role.



Participants are not being asked to complete schoolwork for another person, take courses for another person, impersonate anyone, complete exams for anyone, or violate academic policies.



Minimum Requirements



Applicants must meet the following requirements:



• Must be a law graduate, JD graduate, LLB graduate, or have strong proof of legal education

• Non bar passers may apply

• Must have a good GPA or strong academic record

• Must provide proof of graduation

• Must provide law school diploma, certificate of graduation, or equivalent proof

• Must provide Transcript of Records or official school transcript

• Must have strong legal reading, writing, research, and study skills (Thesis/PhD Knowledge)

• Must be very studious and able to learn independently

• Must be comfortable with self paced online learning

• Must be familiar with Canvas or similar online learning platforms

• Must be familiar with Turnitin or originality review systems

• Must be familiar with discussion boards and online course style learning

• Must know or be willing to follow APA academic writing format

• Must have regular access to a reliable PC or laptop

• Must have stable internet access

• Must be able to submit clean, organized, and quality law related academic work

• Must communicate consistently and provide progress updates



Who This Is For



This opportunity is best for:



• Law graduates with strong academic habits

• JD or LLB graduates

• Non bar passers with strong legal knowledge

• Straight A students or applicants with strong study discipline

• People who love studying law and legal systems

• People who enjoy academic writing and legal research

• People who are organized and detail oriented

• People interested in tutoring, academic support, nonprofit work, or program testing

• People who can work independently without constant supervision

• People who are reliable, respectful, and serious about finishing what they start

• People who are available, responsive, and comfortable working online



Character and Reliability Required



Before anything else, character and reliability come first.



We carefully observe applicants during the first sessions. Intelligence alone is not enough. We need people who are dependable, honest, respectful, and consistent.



We are looking for people who:



• Follow through on commitments

• Communicate respectfully

• Provide daily progress updates

• Complete assignments they start

• Take responsibility seriously

• Stay responsive and professional

• Produce clean and quality work

• Have strong study habits

• Learn well independently

• Care about details and accuracy



If an applicant stops responding, disappears, submits careless work, abandons assignments, or fails to communicate, participation will end.



About the Program



Participants will complete structured law related academic modules and submit original academic work.



Each program includes:



• 15 structured modules

• Assigned law related study topics

• APA style essays

• PowerPoint presentations with speaker notes

• Proper citations and references

• Discussion board style learning activities when assigned

• Final capstone project

• Program feedback when requested



Each module requires:



• Original academic writing

• APA style formatting

• Proper citations and references

• Organized legal research

• Clear presentation work

• Quality writing and attention to detail



Possible Law Related Areas



Program topics may include:



• Legal research

• Legal writing

• Case reading and case analysis

• Legal ethics

• Constitutional law

• Criminal law

• Civil law

• Contracts

• Torts

• Evidence

• Administrative law

• Political law

• Labor law

• Business law

• Family law

• Property law

• Statutory interpretation

• Law and public policy

• Legal systems

• Access to justice



Pay and Program Structure



• Honorarium ranges from PHP 4,500 for beginners to PHP 7,000 after passing the first stage per completed program

• Final honorarium may depend on the agreement, qualifications, work quality, and completion requirements

• Program length is approximately 8 weeks

• Program is self paced and competency based

• Strong applicants may finish in about 7-8 weeks

• Payment is based on successful completion of the required program work

• Poor quality, incomplete, copied, careless, or non original work will not be accepted



Academic Writing and Original Work Requirement



Academic writing in APA style is mandatory.



Applicants are expected to already be strong in:



• Legal writing

• Legal research

• Organization

• Citations

• Academic formatting

• Quality academic work

• Legal analysis



All work must be original and written by the applicant.



AI generated writing is not allowed.



AI tools may only be used for limited support, such as:



• Brainstorming

• Outlining

• Grammar review

• Study support



However:



• Copying is not allowed

• Plagiarism is not allowed

• AI generated submissions are not allowed

• Careless rewriting is not allowed

• Sources must be cited properly in APA style

• Originality checks may be used through Turnitin or similar review systems

• Work must be suitable for originality review because it is genuinely original, properly cited, and written honestly

• Applicants must submit only their own original work



We are looking for applicants who are genuinely good at law related academic work and can study, write, research, cite, organize, and present properly without depending on AI to do the work for them.



What This Can Lead To



Applicants who demonstrate strong work ethic, honesty, consistency, quality work, and reliable communication may be invited to support future paid nonprofit programs.



We continue working only with people who show:



• Reliability

• Consistent communication

• Dependable work quality

• Professionalism

• Trustworthiness

• Respectful attitude

• Strong academic effort

• Careful and quality submissions



How to Apply



 your application to:







Message also through WhatsApp if you receive no response:




Please include:



• Updated resume

• Full name and timezone

• Daily availability in hours per day

• Legal education background

• Strongest law subjects

• Writing sample, 1 to 2 pages in APA style

• PowerPoint sample, 5 to 10 slides with speaker notes

• Confirmation statement below



Confirmation Statement



“I understand this is a nonprofit law learning program testing participant role. I understand that I am not being asked to complete schoolwork, courses, exams, or assignments for another person. I understand originality checks may be used. AI generated writing is not allowed. AI may only be used for limited assistance. I will submit only original work and include proper APA citations where required. I also understand that quality work, reliability, and consistent communication are required.”



Required Documents



• Resume or portfolio

• Proof of graduation

• Law school diploma, front and back

• Transcript of Records, front and back

• Proof of GPA or academic standing, if available

• Bar admission or legal certifications, if available



Qualified applicants may be invited for a phone interview.



Please read the full post carefully before asking questions already answered here.



Apply only if you are serious, studious, reliable, respectful, academically strong, familiar with Canvas and Turnitin, comfortable with the honorarium budget, and ready to complete quality law related academic work.

title: Senior Accountant
description:
Senior Accountant — Full-Time Remote

US Fintech Client • Big 4 / MNC Background Preferred



WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU

- PHP 80,000–120,000/month, commensurate with experience. Plus two bonuses each year— mid-year and year-end.

- 100% remote, forever. Work from Davao, Cebu, Baguio, the beach, the mountains —wherever you do your best work.

- No staffing tetris. You're dedicated full-time to ONE US client. No juggling five accounts, no context-switching. Real ownership, real career growth.

- 24 days of paid time off. Not to escape your job — to live your life on your terms.

- Direct mentorship from Jane Eagle (outsourced CFO, former Big 4) and real exposure to US executive teams. You'll learn at the level you want to be at, not just at the level your current role requires.

- PHP 5,000 monthly health stipend — apply it toward the HMO or insurance that fits your life.

- High bar, with us in your corner. Our client has high standards and moves fast — but you're working with us, not for them. We hire people who take pride in great work, and we make sure you have the support, structure, and advocacy to do it well.



ABOUT ME

Mom, surfer, party-lover, and teller of jokes. I help the world's biggest companies — and scrappy startups — make sense of their money as a fractional CFO (Big 4 alum, Berkeley & NYU MBA). Through Jane Eagle Consulting, I hire from a narrow pool — CPAs from top PH universities with Big 4 or large MNC experience — and place them with growing US clients. For this role, I'm the fractional CFO, so when I hire you, I'm hiring you onto a team I'm already on. If you've got high standards, want to learn from someone who's been in the seat, and still want a real life outside of work — let's talk.



ABOUT THE ROLE

We're hiring a Senior Accountant for our US-based fintech client (B2B payments technology). You'll report directly to the company's Controller and own the day-to-day accounting — AR, AP, and month-end close — for a growing, well-funded company.



This is a hands-on Senior Accountant seat, not a leadership role. You'll be in the books daily and partnering closely with the Controller, Customer Success, and engineering teams. There is real growth potential as the business scales.



The client moves fast and sets a high bar — you'll be doing real, meaningful work. The benefit of working with Jane Eagle Consulting: you have us in your corner. We mentor, advocate for you, and make sure you have what you need to succeed.



WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

Accounts Receivable & Collections

• Generate and review monthly invoices in QuickBooks Online (QBO)

• Identify and flag discrepancies; perform month-over-month variance analysis

• Verify subscription start dates for newly onboarded merchants

• Follow up with merchants on outstanding invoices and manage collections

• Partner with Customer Success on renewals validation

• Support ad hoc reporting on revenue and collections



Accounts Payable & Vendor Management

• Review incoming vendor invoices and categorize to appropriate expense accounts

• Manage approval workflows in Ramp

• Flag and escalate material invoice amounts for review



General Bookkeeping & Month-End Close

• Maintain and execute the month-end checklist (accruals, prepaids, fixed assets)

• Record and reconcile bonus accruals, commission accruals, and payroll entries

• Perform monthly bank reconciliations

• Manage fixed asset, depreciation, and amortization schedules

• Manage the company's virtual mailbox (Earth Class Mail)



WHO YOU NEED TO BE

• Certified Public Accountant (CPA), Philippines

• Bachelor's degree in Accountancy from a top Philippine university (Ateneo, UP, La Salle, UST, or equivalent)

• 4-8 years of accounting experience

• Big 4 audit experience (SGV/EY, Isla Lipana/PwC, KPMG, Deloitte) OR senior accounting experience at a large US/multinational corporation

• Hands-on experience with QuickBooks Online (QBO) — non-negotiable for this role

• Strong Excel skills (pivot tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, financial modeling)

• Solid understanding of US GAAP

• Direct experience with full-cycle month-end close, journal entries, and reconciliations

• Excellent written and spoken English

• Available during Pacific or Eastern Standard Time hours



NICE TO HAVE

• Experience with subscription/SaaS revenue, recurring billing, or partner revenue share models

• Familiarity with Ramp, Salesforce/HubSpot, or Earth Class Mail

• Comfort working with AI tools (e.g., Claude) for research and workflow automation



HOW TO APPLY

We want to get to know you — not just your resume. Send us:

1. Your updated resume (PDF preferred)

2. A short written note OR a short video — whichever you prefer — telling us about your professional background (especially your Big 4 or MNC experience and your most recent hands-on QuickBooks Online work), why you want this role specifically, and one thing most people would be surprised to learn about you



Looking forward to hearing from you.

title: People Operations Specialist
description:
We are seeking an experienced HR Coordinator or People Operations Specialist to build and implement a full-cycle HR system from scratch. This is a builder role — not a maintenance role. The ideal candidate is a systems thinker who can create the policies, templates, frameworks, and processes a scaling business needs, then own their execution going forward.



# Key Responsibilities



## HR Foundation



- Build and maintain the employee handbook covering policies, PTO, code of conduct, remote work expectations, anti-harassment, and confidentiality

- Design a full onboarding system including new hire checklists, welcome
 sequences,
day plans, and training roadmaps

- Document all current roles with responsibilities, KPIs, reporting structure, and success metrics

- Build and maintain the organizational chart reflecting current and future-state structure, reporting lines, and contractor vs. employee designations



## Recruiting & Hiring



- Develop a standardized hiring process including interview scorecards, candidate evaluation forms, reference checks, and offer letter templates

- Create recruiting assets: job posting templates, career page recommendations, and candidate communication templates including rejection and follow-up messaging



## Performance Management



- Build a performance review system covering 30-day, 90-day, and annual reviews, plus a PIP template- Manager will be the one to talk

- Develop a KPI and accountability framework for each role including weekly KPIs, monthly scorecards, and success metrics



## Compliance & Risk Management



- Prepare core employment documents: offer letters, independent contractor agreements, NDAs, non-solicitation agreements, and acknowledgment forms

- Conduct an HR compliance audit covering employee vs. contractor classification, multi-state compliance, payroll processes, labor law postings, and personnel file requirements



## Culture & Retention



- Design an employee recognition program including core values recognition, monthly awards, anniversary milestones, and a referral program

- Build an employee engagement framework covering stay interviews, exit interviews, surveys, and structured feedback loops



# Skills & Qualifications



## Essential



- Proven experience building HR systems, policies, and infrastructure — not just administering them

- Strong knowledge of employment law, compliance requirements, and multi-state HR considerations

- Excellent written communication for policy and documentation development

- Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple workstreams across all five HR phases simultaneously

- Comfortable working independently in a remote, fast-moving environment



# Ideal Candidate Profile



A systems-minded HR professional who builds with intention. They know how to create structure that actually gets used, write policies that actually get followed, and design people processes that support growth without creating bureaucracy. They take full ownership of the HR function and treat it as a strategic asset — not a back-office function.



Payroll- understanding, set up this process and system.



**ADP**



To apply, please send your updated resume with your self-intro. Incomplete application will not be entertained.

title: Video Editor
description:
Short-Form Video Editor — Car Content Specialist (Reels + YouTube) — Full-Time | $3/hour or Per-Video

Type: Full-Time (40 hrs/week) — open to starting part-time for the right person

Pay: Two compensation options — you choose which works best for you:



Option 1 — Hourly: $3.00/hour USD ($120/week, ~$520/month at 40 hrs/week). Paid weekly via Wise.

Option 2 — Per-Video: $1.50 per published reel (no hourly rate). Paid weekly via Wise.



Include your preference in your application.

Schedule: Monday–Friday, minimum 3 hours daily overlap with US Pacific Time (Los Angeles)

Start: Immediately for the right person



About the Brand

You'll be editing for the personal brand of a young entrepreneur based in Los Angeles. The content centers on luxury and exotic cars — cinematic rolling shots, POV drives, cold starts, exhaust clips, and lifestyle content — with a YouTube channel launching soon. The page is built on fast-paced, premium, scroll-stopping edits.

This is not a generalist editing job. If you don't watch car content, don't know what a good launch clip sounds like, or can't feel when a cut should hit the beat — this isn't for you.



The Role

You will receive raw iPhone footage via cloud folder and turn it into finished car edits. You will produce:



Instagram Reels — fast, punchy, hook-driven car edits (the priority)

YouTube videos — long-form content as the channel launches

Cross-platform cuts — TikTok, YouTube Shorts,
 versions



Your day-to-day:



Edit and deliver short-form car edits on a consistent daily/weekly schedule

Cut for retention — a hook in the first 1–3 seconds, tight pacing, zero dead air

Sound design — this is where car edits are won or lost. Engine and exhaust audio mixed properly with music, beat-synced cuts, SFX, clean transitions between natural sound and track

Speed ramps, zoom transitions, velocity-style edits, smooth slow-mo

Color grade automotive footage so paint, reflections, and night shots actually pop

Edit primarily in the Edits app by Instagram (required workflow — non-negotiable)

Deliver in both 9:16 (Reels/Shorts/TikTok) and 16:9 (YouTube)

Stay on top of what's trending in the car content niche — formats, sounds, hooks — and bring ideas, not just deliverables

Communicate daily on progress and turnaround





Requirements (Must-Have)



3+ years of video editing experience — verifiable

Must own an iPhone (iPhone 11 or newer) — the entire workflow runs through the Edits app by Instagram, and you must be fully comfortable editing in it

Short-form specialist — Reels, TikToks, Shorts. You live in this format

YouTube editing experience — you've edited full-length YouTube videos, not just shorts

Strong sound design skills — you understand how to balance engine audio with music and cut to the beat

Portfolio with proof: You must provide the exact 
 of accounts you've created content for, tell us which specific videos you edited, and your exact role on each. We will verify. No real accounts with your real work = no application

Fast, stable internet — you'll be downloading large 4K iPhone files daily - Upload a photo of your internet speed.

Strong written English and reliable daily communication

Willing to sign an NDA — footage, locations, and content plans stay private, and nothing gets reposted to your own pages without written approval



Heavily Weighted (Tell Us If You Have This)



Car/automotive content editing experience — if you've edited for car pages, dealerships, automotive creators, or detailing/wrap shops, lead with it. Show us your best automotive edits

CapCut, Premiere Pro, or After Effects as secondary tools

Thumbnail design for YouTube

Basic motion graphics

Understanding of Instagram analytics and what drives retention and shares in the car niche





How We Hire



Apply with everything listed below

Shortlisted applicants do a paid test edit — we send you raw car footage, you deliver a finished reel, we pay you for your time

The best test edit gets the job, starting with a 2-week paid trial (trial period is hourly regardless of your chosen pay structure)





How to Apply

Start your application with the word "REDLINE" as the very first word. Applications that don't will be deleted unread — this is how we filter people who don't pay attention to detail.

Then include:



A Loom video (3–5 minutes) — screen-record your best edit (a car edit if you have one) and walk us through it: why that hook, why you cut where you cut, how you handled the audio, and what you'd improve. We want to hear how you think

Links to your 5 best short-form edits you personally edited — car content first if you have it

The exact 
 of every account you've created content for, with your specific role on each

Your YouTube editing samples — channel or video links

Answers to these four questions:



You're handed 5 minutes of raw footage from a supercar shoot — rolling shots, interior clips, a cold start, and a launch. Walk us through your exact process to turn it into a 12-second reel, and how long it takes you

Which pay structure do you prefer — hourly or per-video — and why? If hourly, what is your desired hourly rate?



Why This Role Matters

This isn't backlog work. You'd be the founding editor for a personal brand with a real garage, real content output, and a YouTube channel about to launch. The person who takes this seat and delivers grows with it — into a Lead Editor role with consistent long-term work, weekly pay, and genuine creative input. Car content is the niche; if it's your niche, this is the kind of seat you want.

If you've read this far and you're the right person, you already know it. Show us.

title: E-commerce Admin Assistant
description:
We are a growing UK-based e-commerce company seeking a highly experienced, reliable Admin Assistant to support our daily operations across multiple marketplaces. This is a long-term role for someone detail-oriented, proactive, and comfortable working with data, reporting, and backend systems.



Key Responsibilities:

-Monitor Amazon (UK/EU & US) accounts and track key metrics

-Submit and follow up on Amazon cases based on the provided direction

-Perform product listing updates and optimizations

-Monitor inventory reports and flag actionable items

-Update stock levels across Shopify and Tesco Marketplace

-Track and log significant listing changes and performance updates

-Monitor customer feedback and identify trends or issues

-Respond to occasional customer messages based on guidelines

-Manage and track coupons, vouchers, and promotions

-Check and report listing issues (e.g., suppressed or infringing SKUs)

-Assist with monthly reimbursements and basic accounting support



Requirements:

-Strong experience with Amazon Seller Central (UK/EU/US preferred)

-Previous experience in an e-commerce admin or operations role

-High attention to detail and strong organizational skills

-Comfortable working with spreadsheets and data tracking

-Able to follow processes but also think proactively

-Reliable, consistent, and able to work independently

-Good written English communication skills

-Female



Nice to Have:

-Experience with Shopify, Tesco and/or Walmart Marketplace

-Basic knowledge of accounting or reimbursements

-Familiarity with tools or AI to improve efficiency



Working Hours:

Aligned with PH working hours (1:00 PM – 8:30 PM), Monday to Friday



Compensation:

$500–$600/month (depending on experience),

sick leave, vacation leave, 13th month pay, health insurance



Opportunity to grow into a larger role with more responsibilities over time



To Apply, please include:



-Your experience with Amazon (which marketplaces you handled)

-Specific admin tasks you’ve managed (reports, cases, listing updates, etc.)

-Tools or systems you’ve used

-Why you’d be a good fit for a long-term role



A resume also helps.



We are looking for someone we can trust and grow with long-term.

title: Creative Strategist
description:
Who We Are



Rogier’s Ecom Fzco is a fast-moving direct-to-consumer e-commerce company operating multiple brands across Europe, the US, and beyond. We run paid media at scale across Meta, Google, and Pinterest — and we’re building the creative engine that keeps us ahead.



We don’t do slow. We test fast, kill fast, and scale what wins.



The Role



We’re hiring a Creative Strategist to sit directly alongside our Media Buyer and turn winning data into winning creatives — consistently, month over month.



You’re not just making content. You’re studying the market, identifying what stops the scroll, and building ad concepts that convert cold traffic into buyers. You understand that a great visual without a great hook is worthless — and you obsess over both.



What You’ll Do



Daily



? Study winning and losing ads across our brands — understand why they perform



? Fill 2-8 ad briefs per day with content, angles, and visual direction



? Work directly with the Media Buyer to align creative output with what’s working in market



? Review produced creatives inside our CRM and ensure briefs are executed correctly



? Iterate fast on losing concepts — no ego, only data



Weekly



? Perform in-depth market and competitor research



? Attend Monday creative sync — review winners, losers, and new angles



? Deliver new creative batch before Wednesday every week



? Keep 2-5 fresh concepts per winning product in the pipeline at all times



Ongoing



? Source and qualify content creators for UGC generation



? Manage content pipelines to ensure we never run dry on assets



? Build and maintain a creative asset library per brand



? Attend weekly team calls and contribute new ideas proactively



What We’re Looking For



Must-haves



? Minimum 1 year creating or strategizing ads for DTC e-commerce brands



? Proven understanding of direct response — hooks, angles, scroll-stopping formats



? You can write copy AND direct visuals — not one or the other



? Fluent English — written and spoken



? You’ve worked inside a fast-paced remote team before



Character



? You watch ads the way others watch Netflix — obsessively



? Data doesn’t intimidate you — it excites you



? You take feedback without ego and iterate without being asked



? Highly organized, punctual, strong attention to detail



? Coachable and hungry to grow



This Is NOT For You If:



? You need hand-holding to produce work



? You don’t understand e-commerce or paid media



? You’re not obsessed with what makes people buy



? You can’t handle a fast, high-output environment



? You think creativity is just aesthetics



What You Get



? $2,500/month — fully remote



? Work directly with a senior media buyer and see results of your work in real numbers



? Fast-growing multi-brand portfolio — your work scales across multiple markets



? High-performance culture — results are rewarded

title: Tickets Drops Manager
description:
Tickets Drops Manager



About the Role

TT International is looking for an experienced ticketing professional to take ownership of our ticket drop operation.

You will be responsible for identifying profitable drop opportunities, managing drop systems, monitoring the market, and ensuring opportunities are distributed quickly and efficiently to buyers. You will work closely with our Risk, Trading and Tech teams to maximise profitability and improve performance.

• Manage and maintain ticket drop systems.

• Identify profitable events for drop monitoring.

• Monitor Viagogo, TicketWave and other market data sources.

• Track profitability and performance.

• Manage drop inventory and opportunities.

• Work closely with Risk, Trading and Tech teams.

• Improve drop monitoring processes and systems.

• Research new opportunities before they become widely known.

Only apply if you have:

• 2+ years experience within the ticketing industry.

title: BIM Structural Modeler (Revit/AU Client)
description:
You have spent years sharpening your Revit skills on structural steel projects — producing models that are precise, coordinated, and built to be constructed, not just admired on screen. But if your current role isn't giving you the complexity, the project scale, or the professional recognition that your experience deserves, it may be time to take the next step.



About the Company:

Go Ignite is partnering with a well-established Australian mechanical services contractor with a strong national presence. Known for delivering complex, design-and-construct projects across multiple sectors, this organisation has built its reputation on precision engineering and a genuine commitment to prefabrication and BIM as core delivery capabilities. Their team culture is collaborative and grounded in long-term thinking — qualities that carry through to how they engage and support their remote staff.



About the Role:

As a BIM Structural Modeler, you will be the technical backbone of prefabrication and modular steel delivery. Working fully remotely and supporting an Australian team, you will produce the models, drawings, and documentation that take a project from concept to fabrication-ready output. Your work will directly influence how structural steel components are designed, priced, coordinated, and built. You will collaborate closely with Design Managers and BIM Coordinators to ensure models stay accurate, coordinated, and aligned with project deadlines.



What You'll Be Doing:

Generating and editing structural steel elements in Revit — including main members, bracing, purlins, handrails, mesh grating, connection details, and equipment skids

Producing plan, section, isometric, and detailed drawings for prefabricated and modular steel components

Creating concept and tender models from engineering sketches and design instructions

Developing and managing Revit families specific to prefabrication and modular construction workflows

Executing quantity take-offs and scheduling from Revit models for steel, grating, purlins, and handrails

Performing clash detection and participating in design coordination reviews

Coordinating regularly with the Design Manager and BIM Coordinators to meet deliverables, deadlines, and project budgets



What You'll Bring:

Minimum 3 years of Revit modelling and drafting experience, specifically in structural steel projects

Qualifications in Mechanical or Structural Engineering and/or Drafting

Solid understanding of prefabrication and modular construction workflows

Familiarity with Australian construction industry terminology and standards

Working knowledge of Bluebeam Revu and Microsoft Excel

Experience with Tekla Structures or Autodesk Inventor is a strong advantage

Strong attention to detail, clear English communication, and a track record of delivering quality output on time



Why This Opportunity Is Different:

This is a long-term, fully remote engagement with a company that treats BIM and prefabrication as a strategic advantage — not an afterthought. You will work on landmark-scale projects alongside experienced engineers and coordinators, in a team culture built on respect and collaboration. For a skilled Revit modeler ready to work at the standard that tier-one Australian construction demands, this is the kind of role that builds a career.



Compensation and Benefits:

PHP 45,000–60,000 per month

Fully remote setup

Paid Time Off + Prepaid HMO coverage

Performance bonus

Weekends off, dayshift hours



Ready to Apply?

Send your updated CV and portfolio or work samples together with your answers for the below questions:

1. How many years have you been using Revit specifically for structural steel modelling? Describe the types of steel elements you have modelled — for example, main members, bracing, purlins, handrails, or connection details.

2. Have you worked on prefabricated or modular construction projects? If yes, describe your role in the process — from model creation through to drawing production and coordination with fabrication or site teams.

3. How familiar are you with Australian construction industry terminology and standards? Have you previously supported an Australian client or worked on projects following Australian specifications? Please give a specific example if applicable.

4. Which of the following tools have you used professionally, and at what level of proficiency — Revit, Tekla Structures, Autodesk Inventor, and Bluebeam Revu? Please rate yourself (Basic / Intermediate / Advanced) for each tool you have used.

title: Drafting and Estimating Administrator
description:
Remote Drafting & Estimating Administrator (Construction / Structural Steel)

Full-Time (40 hrs/week) 

Work Schedule: Must be available during Australian business hours

Hours: 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM Brisbane (QLD) time

(Includes 1-hour unpaid lunch break and two paid 15-minute breaks)



About the Role



We are seeking an experienced Drafting & Estimating Administrator to provide back-end technical and administrative support within the mining and construction industry, specifically in structural steel fabrication and construction.



This role is critical in ensuring accurate technical documentation, cost estimation, compliance alignment, and overall project support.



Role Overview



This is a multi-functional technical and administrative support role. You will work closely with project managers and engineers to ensure project documentation, compliance requirements, and cost estimates are prepared accurately and on time.



1. Compliance Support

Assist with WHS documentation and compliance tracking

Maintain contractor compliance registers

Support project documentation required for mining and construction site entry. Coordinate the creation of MDR (Manufacturer’s Data Record) packages by collating fabrication drawings, ITPs, material traceability records, weld maps, NDT results, and inspection documentation, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and alignment with project and client requirements.

Track certifications, licences, and expiry dates



2. Drafting Support

Prepare and revise technical drawings using AutoCAD, Tekla, or similar drafting software

Interpret structural and fabrication drawings

Assist in producing shop drawings and as-built documentation

Maintain drawing registers and version control

Coordinate revisions based on engineering or project changes

The ability to create and work with DXF files and NC1 Files





3. Estimating Support

Assist in preparing cost estimates for structural steel projects

Perform quantity take-offs from drawings

Support material costing, labour costing, and project budgeting

Prepare tender documentation support

Maintain estimating records and pricing databases

4. Administrative, Data Entry & Filing

Maintain structured digital filing systems

Ensure accurate data entry into project management systems

Support invoice tracking and documentation collation

Assist with reporting and documentation preparation

Required Skills & Experience

Technical Skills

Proven experience in drafting or construction drafting

Experience supporting estimating in construction or fabrication projects

Strong proficiency in AutoCAD or similar CAD software

Ability to interpret engineering drawings

Experience working within mining or construction environments 

Administrative & Compliance Skills

Strong document control experience

Familiarity with construction compliance 

Strong attention to detail and accuracy

Strong organisational skills

Systems & Software

Microsoft Office Suite and Microsoft 365 Suite

Project management or construction software

Cloud document management platforms

Soft Skills

Strong written communication skills

Ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously

Proactive and solution-focused mindset

High level of confidentiality and professionalism





Qualifications

Degree in Drafting, Engineering, Construction Management, or a similar field (preferred)

Minimum 3+ years’ experience in structural steel/ mining/construction support roles

Demonstrated experience in drafting and estimating support
